Translated Text:
Although it looks exactly like Nagabana,
this Yo-kai—whose entire body is made
of bananas—is completely unrelated to
Nagabana. Its biggest problem is that
insects are constantly drawn to it.

Translated Text:
An elderly serpent Yo-kai who loves
to take charge of everything. For some
reason, when he gives orders with his
fan-shaped tail, you find
yourself unable to disobey him.

その【場：ば】を【仕切：しき】りだす。
その【戦：たたか】いは　【正々堂々：せいせいどうどう】とした
【清々：すがすが】しい【勝負：しょうぶ】になる
Translated Text:
When the battle begins, he appears out of
nowhere and takes charge of the situation.
The battle then becomes a
fair and refreshing contest.

Translated Text:
A snake Yo-kai who’s always sulking.
If this guy possesses you, you’ll become
the kind of petty person who sulks over
even the smallest annoyance.

【自分：じぶん】のオーラで【作：つく】り【出：だ】した
【龍：りゅう】のマフラーを【使：つか】って【戦：たたか】う

Translated Text:
An elite Yo-kai from the Yo-kai
World who fights using a dragon
scarf created from his own aura.
His abilities are top-tier in every respect.

He has served as Orochi's shadow,
carrying out covert operations such as
assassinations. Since anyone who sees
him is eliminated, almost no
one knows of his existence.

Orochi, shining golden with a
dazzling light like the sun radiating
infinitely from a heart of justice.
That light illuminates and
destroys all forms of evil.

「【妖怪解説：ようかいかいせつ】　【真：ま】っ【二：ぷた】つ【斬：き】り！」

Jibanyan's ancestor.
Using a sword with legendary
sharpness---------------------------------“Yo-kai
Explanation: Split in Two!”
—he cuts like this.

The legendary Komasan, who possesses
the spirit of Shura. He incinerates his
enemies with flames reaching tens of
thousands of degrees, summoned from
hell.

For some reason, the legendary
human-faced dog has become
incredibly handsome.
He brings you comfort
with his charming smile.

Long ago, there was a legendary old man
known as "Himo-ji," who is said to have
filled the town with cherry blossoms.
Those blossoms are said to
possess the power to revive souls.

The strongest demon, born from
the "Demon Realm," with a
golden-yellow hue. Its power is
so immense that there is nothing
more to say.

【修行：しゅぎょう】も　ゆっくりなため

A lion with a laid-back personality.
He aspires to become a
fine samurai, but since he takes
his training at a leisurely pace, his
skills are still those of a novice.
Before you know it, he’s taking a nap.

A foot soldier who became more
hooked on cleaning than on battle.
His cleaning skills are flawless
and have earned him high praise
even from the higher-ups.
Rumor has it he’s about to be
appointed as the shogun
tasked with protecting the lord.

【理由：りゆう】はわからないが

Translated Text:
I don't know why, but he's always
fuming with anger. The way he
stomps his feet while shouting,
"I'm mad! I'm mad!" is so cute
that no one takes him seriously.

【腕前：うでまえ】はふつうだが　なぜか
めっぽう【鬼：おに】には【強：つよ】い。
【鬼：おに】と【渡：わた】り【合：あ】える【力：ちから】を【持：も】つ
【数少：かずすく】ない【妖怪：ようかい】とされている。
ひも【爺：じい】の【大：だい】のお【気：き】に【入：い】り。

His skills are average, but for some
reason, he’s exceptionally strong against
demons. He’s considered one of the few
Yo-kai capable of holding his own against
demons.
He’s Himo-jii’s absolute favorite.

【風呂場：ふろば】に【出没：しゅつぼつ】し　【風呂桶：ふろおけ】に

It appears in the bathroom and
licks the grime caked onto the
bathtub. If you become
possessed by it, your sense of taste
becomes so strange that you start
craving nothing but bizarre foods.

This is Akame in her demon form. Her
long tongue is caked with
filth, and wherever she licks,
it leaves a sticky, dirty mess.

【地面：じめん】から【少：すこ】し【浮：う】いているが
【性格：せいかく】は　【地：ち】に【足：あし】が【着：つ】いており

A cat-like Yo-kai that floats in the air.
Although it hovers slightly above the
ground, it has a down-to-earth
personality and is very dependable.
The scar on its forehead
is a badge of honor.

【大切：たいせつ】な【田：た】んぼを【奪：うば】われた【老人：ろうじん】が

【泥田坊：どろたぼう】が　【田：た】んぼに【住：す】みつくと

An elderly man, having been robbed
of his cherished rice paddy, turned
into a Yo-kai through the power of his
resentment. It is said that whenever
Doritabo takes up residence in a rice
paddy, the resentful cry, “Give me back
my paddy…,” can be heard every night.

【憎：にく】しみの【心：こころ】にとらわれ

【田：た】んぼを【通：とお】りがかった【人：ひと】の
【足：あし】をつかんで【引：ひ】きずり【込：こ】む。
Translated Text:
The form of Doritabō after
he became a demon.
Consumed by hatred, his power of
vengeance has grown. He grabs
the legs of anyone passing through
the rice paddies and drags them in.

『ブリーズビートキャンプ』で

Bree, everyone’s favorite leader,
is famous for “Breeze Beat Camp,” an
exercise routine that’s a huge hit among
Yo-kai. She just can’t help but get
everyone around her to join in the fun!

カブトが【汚：よご】れていただけで
【家来：けらい】の【首：くび】を　はねることもあり
みんなを【震：ふる】え【上：あ】がらせている。
Translated Text:
A general who rose to power
through his cleaning skills. He is
so obsessed with cleanliness that he
has even beheaded a retainer simply
for having a dirty helmet, striking fear
into the hearts of everyone around him.

Original Text:
【実力：じつりょく】を【開花：かいか】させた【獅子：しし】まる。
しかし　なかなか
【真：しん】の【実力：じつりょく】を【見：み】せようとせず
【満：まん】を【持：じ】して【行動：こうどう】するので
【見：み】ているほうは　じれったい。
Translated Text:
Shishimaru has finally
shown his true potential.
However, he’s reluctant to reveal his
full capabilities and waits until the
moment is just right to act, which is
frustrating for those watching.

Original Text:
おにぎり【侍：ざむらい】が　こんがり【焼：や】けて
【焼：や】きおに【斬：ぎ】りに【進化：しんか】した。
【鬼：おに】を【焼：や】く【炎：ほのお】の【刀：かたな】を【持：も】つ。
この【姿：すがた】は　お【肌：はだ】が【固：かた】いので
ひも【爺：じい】には【不評：ふひょう】らしい。
Translated Text:
The Onigiri Samurai has been roasted
to a golden brown and evolved into
the "Grilled Onigiri Samurai." He
wields a flaming sword that burns
demons. Apparently,
this form isn't very popular with Grandpa
String because his skin is so tough.

Original Text:
【鬼：おに】を【食：く】いものにするという
おそろしい【妖怪：ようかい】。
【鬼：おに】を【丸呑：まるの】みにできるほど
【巨大：きょだい】な【口：くち】を【持：も】つが
ときどき　おなかを【壊：こわ】すとか。
Translated Text:
A terrifying Yo-kai that feeds on ogres.
It has a mouth so huge it can swallow
ogres whole, but apparently, it
sometimes gets an upset stomach.

Original Text:
【命：いのち】だけを【取：と】り【出：だ】して【食：く】らう
おそろしい【妖怪：ようかい】。
【命：いのち】を【取：と】られた【体：からだ】は【傷：きず】ひとつなく
【寝：ね】ているように【見：み】えるため
【命：いのち】を【取：と】られたと【気付：きづ】けない。
Translated Text:
A terrifying Yo-kai that extracts
and devours only a person’s life.
Since the body from which the
life has been taken appears to be sleeping
without a single scratch, the victim is
unaware that their life has been taken.

Original Text:
【強風：きょうふう】で【裏返：うらがえ】ってしまった
ビニール【傘：がさ】の【無念：むねん】が
【妖怪：ようかい】となった【姿：すがた】。
【生：う】まれ【変：か】わることができるなら
【壊：こわ】れない【強：つよ】い【傘：かさ】になりたい…。
Translated Text:
The frustration of a plastic umbrella
that was turned inside out by strong
winds has taken the form of a Yo-kai.
If I could be reborn, I’d want to be a
strong umbrella that never breaks…

Original Text:
【線香：せんこう】などの　【煙：けむり】がある【場所：ばしょ】なら
どこにでも【発生：はっせい】する【妖怪：ようかい】。
こえんらが【成長：せいちょう】すると
えんらえんらになるが
その【前：まえ】に【消：き】えることが【多：おお】い。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that appears anywhere there
is smoke, such as from incense. When
Koenra matures, it becomes Enraenra, but
it often disappears before that happens.

Original Text:
どんな【問題：もんだい】をおこしても
その【場：ば】しのぎの【謝罪：しゃざい】で
どんな【批判：ひはん】も　ヒラリヒラリと
かわしてしまう。
【何：なに】があっても【反省：はんせい】しない。
Translated Text:
No matter what problems they
cause, they brush off any criticism
with a half-hearted apology.
They never reflect on their
actions, no matter what happens.

Original Text:
【普通：ふつう】のマネキンだったが
【人間：にんげん】のマネをしていたら
【動：うご】けるようになった。
とりつかれると
【人：ひと】のマネばかりをしたくなる。
Translated Text:
It was just an ordinary mannequin,
but after imitating humans, it
gained the ability to move. Once
possessed, it can't
help but imitate people.

Original Text:
とりついた【人：ひと】を
ウソつきにしてしまう【妖怪：ようかい】。
そもそも　【自分自身：じぶんじしん】が
『エセ【宇宙人：うちゅうじん】』という
ウソの【塊：かたまり】のような【存在：そんざい】。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that turns the people
it possesses into liars.
To begin with, it is itself a being
that is essentially a "fake alien"—a
creature made entirely of lies.

Original Text:
わすれん【帽：ぼう】が　【帽子：ぼうし】から
ワンルームサイズへと【巨大化：きょだいか】。
【食：た】べられる【量：りょう】が【増：ふ】え
【人：ひと】ひとりの【記憶：きおく】をすべて
【食：た】べてしまえるようになった。
Translated Text:
The "Forget-Me-Hat" grew from the size
of a hat to that of a studio apartment.
Its capacity increased, and it
became able to devour all of
a single person's memories.

Original Text:
ゆらゆらと【形：かたち】を【変：か】えながら
【大気中：たいきちゅう】をさまよう　【煙：けむり】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
【煙：けむり】なのでどんな【姿：すがた】にもなれるが
いちばん【評判：ひょうばん】がよかった
【今：いま】の【姿：すがた】が　お【気：き】に【入：い】り。
Translated Text:
A smoke-like Yo-kai that drifts
through the air, swaying and
shifting shape. Since it’s made of
smoke, it can take on any form,
but it’s particularly fond of its
current appearance—the one
that’s been the most popular.

Original Text:
えんらえんらが【怪魔化：かいまか】した【姿：すがた】。
【煙：けむり】は　【強力：きょうりょく】な【毒：どく】になっていて
【吸：す】い【込：こ】んでしまった【人：ひと】を
おなかが【筋肉痛：きんにくつう】になるくらい
ずっと【咳：せ】きこませる。
Translated Text:
This is Enra Enra in his demon form.
The smoke is a powerful poison that
causes anyone who inhales it to
cough continuously until their stomach
aches like they have muscle cramps.

Original Text:
【妖怪屋台：ようかいやたい】のおでん【大将：たいしょう】。
【味：あじ】のある【話：はなし】をしながらくり【出：だ】す
よ～く　【味：あじ】のしみたおでんを
【食：た】べて【育：そだ】つと　【味：あじ】のある
イイ【大人：おとな】になれるらしい。
Translated Text:
The Oden Master at the Yo-kai Food Stall.
They say that if you grow up eating his
oden—which is cooked to perfection
and full of flavor—while listening to
his fascinating stories, you’ll grow up
to be a wonderful, well-rounded adult.

Original Text:
【巨大：きょだい】なドミノのような
【姿：すがた】をした【妖怪：ようかい】。
どんなに【小：ちい】さなことでも
【謝：あやま】りに【謝：あやま】りたおし
【相手：あいて】の【体：からだ】と【心：こころ】を【押：お】しつぶす。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that looks like a giant domino.
It apologizes endlessly—even for
the smallest things—until it crushes
the other person’s body and spirit.

Original Text:
うんがい【鏡：きょう】が【三面：さんめん】になって
【妖力：ようりょく】も【三倍強：さんばいつよ】くなった。
【場所：ばしょ】だけでなく
【時間：じかん】をも【超：こ】えることができる。
タイムパラドックスを【勉強中：べんきょうちゅう】。
Translated Text:
The divination mirror has become a
three-panel mirror, and its magical power
has tripled. It can now transcend not only
space but also time.
I'm currently studying time paradoxes.

Original Text:
【猿：さる】の【頭：あたま】　【虎：とら】の【胴体：どうたい】
【蛇：へび】の【尾：お】を【持：も】つ【妖怪：ようかい】。
ふつうに【鳴：な】いてるだけなのに
【気味：きみ】が【悪：わる】いと　よく【言：い】われて
ちょっと【傷：きず】ついている。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai with the head of a monkey,
the body of a tiger, and the tail of a
snake. People often say it’s creepy
even when it’s just making its
usual sounds, which
hurts my feelings a little.

Original Text:
【風魔：ふうま】の【力：ちから】を【持：も】つ【猿：さる】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
【妖怪：ようかい】になる【前：まえ】は
【伝説的：でんせつてき】な【忍者：にんじゃ】だったらしい。
【今：いま】も【足音：あしおと】を【立：た】てず
【風：かぜ】のように　【宝：たから】を【奪：うば】っていく。
Translated Text:
A monkey Yo-kai with
the power of the Fuma.
Before becoming a Yo-kai, it was
apparently a legendary ninja.
Even now, it steals treasures silently,
moving as swiftly as the wind.

Original Text:
【今：いま】にも【割：わ】れそうな【土器：どき】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
イタズラ【心：ごころ】あふれる【性格：せいかく】で
いつも　【机：つくえ】のギリギリ【落：お】ちるか
【落：お】ちないかの【場所：ばしょ】に【立：た】ち
みんなをドキドキさせる。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai shaped like an
earthenware pot that looks like it’s
about to break at any moment. With a
mischievous personality, it always perches
on the very edge of the desk—just on the
verge of falling—keeping everyone on the
edge of their seats.

Original Text:
いつも【他：ほか】の【人：ひと】のお【弁当：べんとう】を
うらやましそうに【見：み】ている
お【米：こめ】だけのお【弁当妖怪：べんとうようかい】。
とりつかれると　すぐに【他人：たにん】が
うらやましくなってしまう。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that consists solely of rice
and is always looking enviously at
other people’s lunches.
If it possesses you, you’ll
immediately start envying others.

Original Text:
とりつかれると　【暑：あつ】がりになり
【汗：あせ】が【止：と】まらなくなる。
あせっか【鬼：き】に　とりつかれた
【人：ひと】たちが【集：あつ】まった【姿：すがた】は
まさに【地獄絵図：じごくえず】。
Translated Text:
Once possessed, people
become extremely sensitive to
heat and can’t stop sweating.
The sight of people possessed by the
Sweaty Demon gathered together is
truly a scene straight out of hell.

Original Text:
【強力：きょうりょく】な【雷：かみなり】の【力：ちから】をたくわえた
【背中：せなか】の【風呂敷：ふろしき】は
お【母：かあ】さんからもらった【特別製：とくべつせい】。
その【力：ちから】を【槍：やり】に【伝：つた】えて
【強力：きょうりょく】な【一撃：いちげき】を【放：はな】つ。
Translated Text:
The furoshiki on his back, which stores
powerful lightning energy, is a special one
given to him by his mother. He channels
that power into his spear
to deliver a powerful blow.

Original Text:
【極度：きょくど】の【方向：ほうこう】オンチな【妖怪：ようかい】。
【行：い】きたいところに
【乗：の】せていってあげると
【言：い】ったそばから　【道：みち】をそれて
【迷子：まいご】になってしまうらしい。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai with an extremely
poor sense of direction.
Apparently, as soon as you
offer to take it somewhere, it
veers off course and gets lost.

Original Text:
【借：か】りパクに【味：あじ】をしめた
かりパックンが　【積極的：せっきょくてき】に
【泥棒：どろぼう】をするようになった【姿：すがた】。
【盗：ぬす】んだものをパクッとくわえて
【頭：あたま】の【風呂敷：ふろしき】に【溜：た】めこむのだ。
Translated Text:
This is Kari Pakkun, who has gotten a taste
for stealing and has started to actively
commit theft. He snatches up the things he
steals and stashes them in the
furoshiki wrapped around his head.

Original Text:
プライドも【値段：ねだん】も【高：たか】い
【超豪華：ちょうごうか】な【天：てん】ぷら【丼妖怪：どんようかい】。
プライ【丼：どん】に　とりつかれると
プライドが【高：たか】くなって
みんなの【反感：はんかん】を【買：か】うので【注意：ちゅうい】。
Translated Text:
An ultra-luxurious tempura rice
bowl Yo-kai with both high pride
and a high price tag. Be careful—if
you become possessed by the "
Prai-don," your pride will skyrocket
and you’ll earn everyone’s resentment.

Original Text:
【敵軍：てきぐん】を【目指：めざ】して【進：すす】んでいたのに
【迷子：まいご】になった【戦車：せんしゃ】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
【心：こころ】はまっすぐだが
すぐに　【横道：よこみち】にそれてしまい
【目的地：もくてきち】にたどりつけない。
Translated Text:
A tank Yo-kai that got lost while heading
toward enemy forces. Although its
intentions are pure, it easily
strays off course and can
never reach its destination.

Original Text:
【体：からだ】にたくさんの【目：め】がある【鬼：おに】。
どれかひとつの【目：め】だけが
【心臓：しんぞう】につながっていて
そこを【矢：や】で【射：い】ることでしか
【倒：たお】すことができないらしい。
Translated Text:
A demon with many eyes on its body.
Apparently, only one of its eyes
is connected to its heart, and
the only way to defeat it is by
shooting an arrow into that eye.

Original Text:
【全身：ぜんしん】に　ちりばめられた【目：め】は
【宝石：ほうせき】でできており
まばゆい【光：ひかり】を【発：はっ】している。
きらめ【鬼自身：きじしん】も　まぶしくて
【目：め】がくらむこともあるとか。
Translated Text:
The eyes scattered all over its body are
made of jewels and emit a dazzling light.
It is said that even the Kirame-oni itself
is sometimes blinded by the glare.

Original Text:
【男性：だんせい】ホルモンが【爆発：ばくはつ】し
【肉食系男子：にくしょくけいだんし】に【生：う】まれ【変：か】わった。
【日焼：ひや】けボディーに
チャラチャラしたトークで
【女性：じょせい】をナンパしまくる。
Translated Text:
His male hormones went into overdrive,
and he was reborn as a player. With his
tanned body and smooth talk, he
picks up women left and right.

Original Text:
【雷：かみなり】を【集：あつ】めて　【自由：じゆう】に【操：あやつ】る【妖怪：ようかい】。
どんなに【厄介：やっかい】なトラブルも
【避雷針：ひらいしん】のように【受：う】け【止：と】める。
【最近：さいきん】　【引：ひ】き【受：う】けすぎて
【肩：かた】こりが　【気：き】になるらしい。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that gathers lightning and
controls it at will. It takes on even the
most troublesome problems
like a lightning rod.
Lately, it seems to be worried about
stiff shoulders from taking on too much.

Original Text:
おしっこをガマンし【続：つづ】けた【結果：けっか】
あらゆることをガマンできる
【最強：さいきょう】の【忍耐力：にんたいりょく】を【身：み】につけた。
なぜ　そこまでおしっこを
ガマンし【続：つづ】けたかはナゾ。
Translated Text:
As a result of constantly holding in
my pee, I developed the ultimate
patience—the kind that lets me
endure just about anything.
Why I kept holding it in for
so long remains a mystery.

Original Text:
【数百年：すうひゃくねん】　【生：い】きたという
ガマガエルが【変異：へんい】した【姿：すがた】。
【長生：ながい】きのポイントは
【枯：か】れることなく　おしゃれに
【気：き】をつけることだとか。
Translated Text:
A mutated form of a toad said to
have lived for several hundred
years. Apparently, the secret to a
long life is to never let yourself wither
away and to always stay stylish.

Original Text:
【大：おお】ガマの【親：しん】せきの
【巨大：きょだい】ヤモリが【変異：へんい】した【姿：すがた】。
【家：いえ】の【中：なか】が【大好：だいす】きな【引：ひ】きこもりで
【自由奔放：じゆうほんぽう】な【大：おお】ガマとは
あまりウマが【合：あ】わないらしい。
Translated Text:
A mutated form of a giant gecko
related to the Great Toad.
It seems he doesn't get along very
well with the Great Toad, who loves
staying indoors and is a free spirit.

Original Text:
【古典中：こてんちゅう】の【古典：こてん】として
【古：ふる】くから【親：した】しまれている【妖怪：ようかい】。
とりついた【人：ひと】を
【無表情：むひょうじょう】にしてしまう【力：ちから】は
あまり【知：し】られていないようだ。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that has long been beloved
as a classic among classics.
Its ability to render those it
possesses expressionless
seems to be relatively unknown.

Original Text:
これといって【特殊：とくしゅ】な【力：ちから】もなく
【出：で】たら【驚：おどろ】かれるぐらいの
ほとんど【無害：むがい】な【妖怪：ようかい】。
コンタクトレンズが【他：ほか】の【人：ひと】より
【半分：はんぶん】ですむのがうれしい。
Translated Text:
A mostly harmless Yo-kai with no
special powers to speak of—one that
would surprise people if it appeared.
I’m happy that I only need half as many
contact lenses as other people.

Original Text:
【美：うつく】しいラインの【足：あし】の【飛脚：ひきゃく】で
とりついた【人：ひと】を
ものすごい【美脚：びきゃく】にする。
【男：おとこ】がとりつかれると
ムダに【美脚：びきゃく】になって【痛々：いたいた】しい。
Translated Text:
A messenger with beautifully shaped
legs possesses people, giving them
incredibly beautiful legs. When a
man is possessed, his legs
become unnaturally beautiful,
which is kind of painful to watch.

Original Text:
【足：あし】にとりつき　【街：まち】を【走：はし】り【回：まわ】る。
ものすごい【速：はや】さで【爆走：ばくそう】し
【行：い】き【止：ど】まりでも【止：と】まれない。
かけっこ【前：まえ】に　とりつかれれば
【優勝：ゆうしょう】まちがいなし。
Translated Text:
It latches onto your feet and runs
wild through the streets. It races at
incredible speeds and can’t
even stop at dead ends.
If it latches onto you before the race
starts, you’re guaranteed to win.

Original Text:
じめじめした【性格：せいかく】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
【雨女：あめおんな】がとりつくと【雨：あめ】が【降：ふ】るので
【大事：だいじ】なイベントのときに
【雨：あめ】がよく【降：ふ】る【人：ひと】は
うしろに【雨女：あめおんな】がいるかも？
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai with a damp,
gloomy personality. When
a “Rain Woman” possesses someone,
it rains—so if it often rains during
your important events, there might
be a Rain Woman lurking behind you?

Original Text:
とりつかれると　【顔：かお】が【変化：へんか】して
【人：ひと】に【会：あ】うたびに
「そんな【顔：かお】だっけ？」
と【言：い】われてしまう。
【女性：じょせい】にとりつくことが【多：おお】い。
Translated Text:
When I'm possessed, my face changes,
and every time I meet someone, they
say, "Did I look like that?" It often happens
to women.

Original Text:

dreams of someone I'm interested

so-called classic kappa, with a plate
balanced on its head. Its relationship to
Walkappa is unclear, but the difference
in status between the two is obvious.

The original and most prestigious

from a distant foreign land. Even
the kappas who run rampant

This is the form a kappa takes

the river into the water, drowns

A battle-hardened Yo-kai who has
mastered the mysterious energy
known as “Horse.” Though he
usually walks with a cane, it’s said
that in battle, he displays such
sharp movements that he leaves
everyone around him in awe.

The tongue of the Kizuna-meko has
disinfectant properties and can

wounds but also the
bonds between people.

【持：も】ち【主：ぬし】の【笑顔：えがお】を【思：おも】い【出：だ】して
【一本足：いっぽんあし】で　ぴょんぴょんと

This is what an umbrella that has

Remembering its owner’s smile, it
happily hops around on one leg.

から【傘：かさ】お【化：ば】けが【怪魔化：かいまか】した【姿：すがた】。

This is the form the Umbrella

discarded umbrella has been reawakened,
causing it to attack everyone it sees.

A yo-kai with a very docile personality.
Apparently, even "Gurerurin" turned into

A fortune-telling Yo-kai that is

incredible predictive abilities, but
since it’s still in training, the only
things it can predict are tomorrow’s
weather and pop quizzes.

This is Kudan in his demon form.

people cower in fear after he tells

A mischievous child-like Yo-kai that lives

to the homes it inhabits.

The form a "zashiki-warashi"

Misfortune befalls the house it
inhabits time and time again,
eventually leading to the collapse
of the family living there.

It never rains where
the "sunny guy" is. He’s
always full of energy.
He’s currently trying his hardest
to cheer up the "rain girl."

Wakame-kun has risen to become the top
dancer in the seaweed world. Through
his dancing alone, he fills concert
venues all over Japan with fans.

Kizunameko became a nurse to

hospital idol, and many people eagerly
await her “Kizunurse” licking therapy.

【素直：すなお】な【性格：せいかく】のまま　マジメな

Sunao has grown into a diligent

His perfect bow, brimming with
sincerity, makes even those he
greets instinctively feel humbled.

A demon who uses an

provides impenetrable defense;
when closed, it unleashes a
desperate, all-out attack. A powerful
Yo-kai that seamlessly combines
offense and defense.

The deity of the Zashiki-warashi realm.
It is said that simply enshrining a single
strand of the Zashiki-warashi deity’s hair
in one’s home guarantees happiness for
that family for generations to come.

cost of transportation to get to where
he needs to go is his biggest obstacle.

After overcoming rigorous training,

foresee the future. He can foresee
anything, but he absolutely never
uses this ability for evil purposes.

A sacred Yo-kai that protects all

A sacred Yo-kai characterized

The form taken by a well-worn,
old pair of zori that has turned

footsteps but see no one, there
might be a "Yo-kai zori" nearby.

A Yo-kai whose hobby is hiding TV

A Yo-kai resembling a giant serpent

figuring out the location of its weak spot.

A Yo-kai who goes around saying

unreasonable demands on her

A Yo-kai born from the souls

Keukeugen the Demon
is absolutely incurable.

Original Text:
【外人風：がいじんふう】の【三人組妖怪：さんにんぐみようかい】。
【都合：つごう】が【悪：わる】いことが【起：お】きても
「～じゃナイよ！」と
【口裏：くちうら】を【合：あ】わせて
【事実：じじつ】を【認：みと】めようとしない。
Translated Text:
A trio of foreign-looking Yo-kai.
Whenever something goes wrong,
they all say in unison, “That’s not
true!” and refuse to admit the facts.

Original Text:
【何：なに】をやっても
「ワシがすごいんじゃ！」と
【自画自賛：じがじさん】する【妖怪：ようかい】。
【相手：あいて】にするとめんどうなので
【適当：てきとう】に【流：なが】すのがいちばん。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai who brags about how
great he is no matter what he does.
It's a hassle to deal with him, so
it's best to just brush him off.

Original Text:
【学校：がっこう】に【住：す】みつく【女：おんな】の【子：こ】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
【子：こ】どもを【怖：こわ】がらせることを
【使命：しめい】と【考：かんが】えており　【常：つね】に【時代：じだい】に
【合：あ】った【怖：こわ】がらせかたを【研究：けんきゅう】する
ストイックな【一面：いちめん】を【持：も】つ。
Translated Text:
A female Yo-kai who takes up
residence in a school. She
considers it her mission to scare
children and has a stoic side,
constantly researching ways to scare
them that are appropriate for the times.

Original Text:
やわらかい【体：からだ】をしていて
どれだけ【文句：もんく】を【言：い】われても
のらりくらりと【身：み】をかわす。
とりつかれると
【言：い】い【訳：わけ】がやたらと【上手：うま】くなる。
Translated Text:
He has a flexible nature and, no
matter how much people complain, he
just dodges it all with ease. When he
gets obsessed with something,
he becomes incredibly good at
making excuses.

Original Text:
カンペキな【投：な】げ【縄術：なわじゅつ】で
【他人：たにん】のものをぶんどっていく。
【結婚式：けっこんしき】で　【元：もと】カノを
ロープで【取：と】り【戻：もど】したという
【武勇伝：ぶゆうでん】を【持：も】つ。
Translated Text:
He uses his flawless lassoing
skills to snatch things from others.
He’s famous for a heroic tale in
which he used a rope to win back
his ex-girlfriend at a wedding.

Original Text:
【銭湯：せんとう】が【大好：だいす】きなブタ【妖怪：ようかい】。
【好：この】みのお【湯：ゆ】の【温度：おんど】が
すごく【熱：あつ】いため
いっしょにお【風呂：ふろ】に【入：はい】ると
すぐに　のぼせてしまう。
Translated Text:
A pig-like Yo-kai who loves
public bathhouses. Since he
prefers his bath water to be
extremely hot, if you take a bath with
him, you’ll get overheated right away.

Original Text:
【最高：さいこう】の【爆音：ばくおん】を【求：もと】めた【結果：けっか】
【盗：ぬす】んだバイクで【走：はし】り【出：だ】した。
【路上：ろじょう】で　【騒音：そうおん】をまきちらす
【迷惑：めいわく】なやつは　【爆音：ばくおん】ならしに
とりつかれているかも。
Translated Text:
In my quest for the loudest
possible roar, I ended up taking
off on a stolen motorcycle.
Those nuisances who make a racket
on the streets might just be obsessed
with making their bikes roar.

Original Text:
あらゆるものを
ふさふさにしてしまう【妖怪：ようかい】。
ありえない【場所：ばしょ】が
ふさふさしているのは
きっと　この【妖怪：ようかい】のせい。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that makes everything fluffy.
If you find something fluffy in an
unlikely place, it’s surely
this Yo-kai’s doing.

Original Text:
【花子：はなこ】さんが【成長：せいちょう】して
【女子高生：じょしこうせい】になった【姿：すがた】。
【授業：じゅぎょう】もマジメに【聞：き】かず
【呪：のろ】いのことばかり【考：かんが】えている
【危：あぶ】ない【子：こ】になってしまった。
Translated Text:
Hanako has grown up and is now a high
school girl. She’s turned into a
troublemaker who doesn’t pay attention in
class and thinks about nothing but curses.

Original Text:
【平安時代：へいあんじだい】にも【登場：とうじょう】する
ゆいしょ【正：ただ】しい【伝統妖怪：でんとうようかい】。
その【正体：しょうたい】は　【巨大：きょだい】な【蜘蛛：くも】で
ときどき　【気：き】まぐれに
その【姿：すがた】を【見：み】せることがある。
Translated Text:
A traditional Yo-kai with a well-established
history dating back to the Heian period.
Its true form is that of a giant spider, and
it occasionally reveals itself on a whim.

Original Text:
【毒：どく】のスペシャリスト。
ケーキに【毒：どく】を【入：い】れたり
【毒口紅：どくくちべに】によるキスなど
【女子力：じょしりょく】が【高：たか】い【作戦：さくせん】を【好：この】むが
れっきとした　【男性：だんせい】である。
Translated Text:
A poison specialist. Although he
prefers "girly" tactics—such as lacing
cakes with poison or kissing
with poisoned lipstick—he is, in
fact, a man through and through.

Original Text:
ケマモト【村：むら】の【村：むら】おこしのために
がんばる　ご【当地：とうち】キャラ【妖怪：ようかい】。
『キャラ』と『【妖怪：ようかい】』の【間：あいだ】で
【日々：ひび】　【悩：なや】み【考：かんが】えながら
【活動：かつどう】を【続：つづ】けている。
Translated Text:
A local mascot-Yo-kai working hard
to revitalize Kemamoto Village.
He continues his activities while wrestling
daily with the dilemma of balancing his
roles as both a “mascot” and a “Yo-kai.”

Original Text:
いつも【寝違：ねちが】えていて
【首：くび】を【気：き】にしているカエル【妖怪：ようかい】。
とりつかれると
どんなに【高級：こうきゅう】な【枕：まくら】で【寝：ね】ても
【絶対：ぜったい】に【寝違：ねちが】えてしまう。
Translated Text:
A frog Yo-kai who’s always worried
about his neck because he constantly
wakes up with a stiff neck. If he
possesses you, you’ll definitely
wake up with a stiff neck no matter
how expensive your pillow is.

Original Text:
からみぞんに　とりつかれると
【絡：から】むとロクなことがない【人：ひと】に
なってしまう。
【話：はなし】がスムーズに【進：すす】まないときは
【近：ちか】くにいたりするのかも。
Translated Text:
If you get caught up in Karamizon, you’ll
turn into the kind of person who never
ends up doing anything good. Maybe
they’re lurking nearby whenever
a conversation isn’t going smoothly.

Original Text:
イヤホンで　【音楽：おんがく】を
きいている【人：ひと】にとりつき
【音楽：おんがく】を【外：そと】にダダ【漏：も】れにする。
【電車：でんしゃ】の【中：なか】では　とくに
とりつかれている【人：ひと】が【多：おお】い。
Translated Text:
It attaches itself to people listening
to music with earphones and
causes the music to leak out loudly.
There are especially many
people affected by this on trains.

Original Text:
【背中：せなか】に【背負：せお】った
スッポンを【頭：あたま】にはめて
「スッポン！」と【引：ひ】き【抜：ぬ】けば
【忘：わす】れていたことを【思：おも】い【出：だ】せる。
【頭：あたま】のモヤモヤもスッキリ。
Translated Text:
If you put the soft-shelled turtle you’re
carrying on your back on your head and
pull it off while shouting, “Soft-shelled
turtle!” you’ll remember what you’d
forgotten. It’ll also clear up any
mental fog.

Original Text:
どんこ【池：いけ】を【守：まも】る【池：いけ】の【主：ぬし】。
【魚：さかな】たちからの【人望：じんぼう】は【厚：あつ】く
【海水魚：かいすいぎょ】にも【尊敬：そんけい】されている。
つられたろう【丸：まる】が【一声：ひとこえ】かければ
【大量：たいりょう】の【魚：さかな】が【集：あつ】まるのだ。
Translated Text:
The guardian of Donko Pond.
He is deeply beloved by the fish and
even respected by saltwater fish.
When Taroumaru, who has been caught,
calls out, a huge school of fish gathers.

Original Text:
ムカムカしているムカデ【妖怪：ようかい】。
とりつかれると　とにかく
ムカムカしてしまう。
「【怒：おこ】ってるの？」って【言葉：ことば】は
【火：ひ】に【油：あぶら】をそそぐので【注意：ちゅうい】。
Translated Text:
A centipede Yo-kai that
makes you feel queasy.
If it possesses you,
you’ll just feel queasy. Be careful
not to ask, “Are you angry?”—it’ll
just add fuel to the fire.

Original Text:
【人間：にんげん】の【上半身：じょうはんしん】に
【魚：さかな】の【下半身：かはんしん】を【持：も】つ【妖怪：ようかい】。
とても【美：うつく】しい【声：こえ】で【歌：うた】を【歌：うた】う。
いつもは【海：うみ】の【中：なか】にいるので
【陸：りく】の【人：ひと】には【興味：きょうみ】いっぱい。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai with the upper body of a human
and the lower body of a fish. It sings with a
very beautiful voice. Since it
usually lives in the ocean, it is
very curious about people on land.

Original Text:
にんぎょが【怪魔化：かいまか】した【姿：すがた】。
【近：ちか】づいてきた【船：ふね】を
【美：うつく】しい【歌：うた】で　【嵐：あらし】の【中：なか】にさそい
【遭難：そうなん】させたり
【沈没：ちんぼつ】させて【遊：あそ】んでいる。
Translated Text:
A mermaid who has been
transformed into a demon. She lures
approaching ships into storms
with her beautiful singing,
causing them to run aground or
sink—all for her own amusement.

Original Text:
【首：くび】が【長：なが】く【伸：の】びるという
【能力：のうりょく】を【持：も】った【妖怪：ようかい】。
【首：くび】さえ【伸：の】ばさなければ
【妖怪：ようかい】とは【気：き】づかれないが
つい【伸：の】ばさずにはいられない。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai with the ability
to stretch its neck.
As long as it doesn't stretch its
neck, no one realizes it's a Yo-kai,
but it just can't help stretching it.

Original Text:
ろくろ【首：くび】が【怪魔化：かいまか】した【姿：すがた】。
【長：なが】く【伸：の】ばした【首：くび】を
【凶器：きょうき】として【使：つか】い
【無抵抗：むていこう】な【人：ひと】たちを
しめつけて【苦：くる】しませる。
Translated Text:
The form of a Rokurokubi that
has become a demon. It uses its
long, extended neck as a weapon to
strangle and torment defenseless people.

Original Text:
なんでも　すぐに【決断：けつだん】できず
【保留：ほりゅう】にしてしまう【龍：りゅう】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
とりつかれると
「とりあえず【保留：ほりゅう】！」が
【口：くち】ぐせになってしまう。
Translated Text:
A dragon-like Yo-kai that can’t
make decisions right away and
always puts things on hold.
If you’re possessed by it, “Let’s
just put it on hold for now!”
becomes your catchphrase.

Original Text:
【大地：だいち】を【震：ふる】わせるほどの【勢：いきお】いで
【怒：いか】りを【爆発：ばくはつ】させる【妖怪：ようかい】。
【激：げき】ドラゴンにとりつかれると
【怒：いか】りで【我：われ】を【忘：わす】れ　【家：いえ】のお【皿：さら】は
すべて【割：わ】れてしまうほど。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai that unleashes a rage
powerful enough to shake the earth.
When possessed by the Fierce
Dragon, it loses all self-control in
its fury—to the point where every
plate in the house shatters.

Original Text:
【記憶：きおく】をつかさどる【神様：かみさま】。
【不思議：ふしぎ】な【掃除機：そうじき】を【使：つか】って
【記憶：きおく】を【吸：す】い【出：だ】せば
まさかの【前世：ぜんせ】の【記憶：きおく】まで
【思：おも】い【出：だ】すことができる。
Translated Text:
The god who governs
memories. If you use a
mysterious vacuum cleaner to suck
out memories, you might even
recall memories from a past life.

Original Text:
うっとうしい【口調：くちょう】で
【話：はなし】をこじらせる【金髪：きんぱつ】ギャル。
こんがらギャルによって
トラブルがこじれて
【崩壊：ほうかい】した【友情：ゆうじょう】は【多：おお】いらしい。
Translated Text:
A blonde gal who complicates things
with her annoying tone of voice.
It seems there are many cases where
friendships have fallen apart because of
trouble caused by these meddlesome gals.

Original Text:
【遠：とお】い【昔：むかし】からいる【妖怪：ようかい】だが
ピチピチのお【肌：はだ】を【保：たも】っている。
【八百比丘尼：やおびくに】に【愛：あい】されると
【不老不死：ふろうふし】を【手：て】に【入：い】れることが
できるらしい。
Translated Text:
Although she is a Yo-kai who has
existed since ancient times, she
maintains a youthful complexion.
It is said that if you are loved by
Yaobikuni, you can attain eternal life.

Original Text:
あらゆる【生命：せいめい】の【源：みなもと】である
【神：かみ】のような【妖怪：ようかい】。
その【証拠：しょうこ】に　そのへんの【神：かみ】は
だいたい【自分：じぶん】が【産：う】んだと
【本人：ほんにん】は【語：かた】っている。
Translated Text:
A god-like Yo-kai who
is the source of all life.
As proof of this, he claims that
he personally gave birth to most
of the gods you see around here.

Original Text:
【長年：ながねん】の【蔵生活：くらせいかつ】で
フユニャンの【体：からだ】に【妖気：ようき】がたまり
【大：おお】きくなってしまった【姿：すがた】。
【体：からだ】にたまった【妖気：ようき】には
【他：ほか】のものまで【大：おお】きくする
【力：ちから】があり　ふれるものを
ばっふぅぅう～～～ん　と
【巨大化：きょだいか】させてしまう。
Translated Text:
After many years living in the cellar,
demonic energy has accumulated in
Fuunyan’s body, causing him to grow
larger. The demonic energy stored
in his body has the power to enlarge other
things as well, causing anything it touches
to grow gigantic with a “Bafuuuuu~~~!”

Original Text:
『ネタバレ』…この【世：よ】で
もっとも　おそれられている
【現象：げんしょう】のひとつ。
ネタバレリーナは　それを
いとも【簡単：かんたん】にやってのける。
Translated Text:
"Spoilers"... one of the most
dreaded phenomena in the world.
Spoilerina pulls it off with ease.

Original Text:
うんちくばかり【言：い】うクマ【妖怪：ようかい】。
【聞：き】いてもいないのに
うんちくを【語：かた】り【出：だ】し
まわりの【人：ひと】から
【迷惑：めいわく】だと【思：おも】われている。
Translated Text:
A bear-like Yo-kai who does
nothing but spout trivia.
He starts rambling about trivia even
when no one has asked him to, and
people around him find him annoying.

Original Text:
【八匹：はっぴき】の【龍：りゅう】が【合体：がったい】した【妖怪：ようかい】。
それぞれの【人格：じんかく】が【残：のこ】っており
コロコロと【人格：じんかく】が【入：い】れかわる。
とりつかれると　【八枚舌：はちまいじた】の
いい【加減：かげん】な【人：ひと】に【思：おも】われるかも。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai formed by the
fusion of eight dragons.
Each dragon retains its own
personality, and their personalities
switch back and forth constantly.
If you’re possessed by it,
people might think you’re a
two-faced, unreliable person.

Original Text:
【怪魔：かいま】の【幹部：かんぶ】の【一人：ひとり】。
【厄介：やっかい】に【思：おも】われることに
【喜：よろこ】びを【感：かん】じる【妖怪：ようかい】。
いやらしさは
【怪魔：かいま】ナンバーワン。
Translated Text:
One of the Kaima’s high-ranking members.
A Yo-kai who takes pleasure in being
a nuisance. He’s the number one
creep among the Kaima.

Original Text:
【怪魔：かいま】の【幹部：かんぶ】の【一人：ひとり】。
【不快：ふかい】な【感情：かんじょう】を【愛：あい】し
【他人：たにん】にも【不快：ふかい】を
【分：わ】け【与：あた】えようとする。
【美：うつく】しさは【怪魔：かいま】ナンバーワン。
Translated Text:
One of the Kaima’s high-ranking
members. She revels in
unpleasant emotions and
seeks to inflict them on others.
She is the most beautiful of all the Kaima.

Original Text:
【怪魔：かいま】の【幹部：かんぶ】の【一人：ひとり】。
なにごとも【豪快：ごうかい】でなければ
【気：き】が【済：す】まない【妖怪：ようかい】。
【単純：たんじゅん】なパワーは
【怪魔：かいま】ナンバーワン。
Translated Text:
One of the Kaima’s high-ranking members.
A Yo-kai who won’t be satisfied unless
everything is done in a grand, spectacular
way. He possesses the greatest
raw power among the Kaima.

Original Text:
【怪魔：かいま】の【幹部：かんぶ】の【一人：ひとり】。
【難：むずか】しい【言葉：ことば】を【使：つか】って
【戸惑：とまど】わせようとする。
【持：も】っている【知識：ちしき】は
【怪魔：かいま】ナンバーワン。
Translated Text:
One of the Kaima's high-ranking officials.
He tries to confuse people
by using difficult words.
He possesses the most
knowledge of anyone in the Kaima.

Original Text:
【怪魔：かいま】の【幹部：かんぶ】の【一人：ひとり】。
【怪魔：かいま】のリーダー【的存在：てきそんざい】で
あらゆる【物：もの】を【破壊：はかい】するという
モットーを【持：も】つ。
【戦闘力：せんとうりょく】は　【怪魔：かいま】ナンバーワン。
Translated Text:
One of the Kaima’s high-ranking members.
He serves as the Kaima’s de
facto leader and lives by the
motto of destroying everything.
He is the Kaima’s strongest fighter.

Original Text:
ドブの【中：なか】に　こもりすぎて
【世界：せかい】の【中心：ちゅうしん】は【自分：じぶん】だと
【思：おも】ってしまったネズミ。
とりつかれると　とっても
【自己中：じこちゅう】になってしまう。
Translated Text:
A mouse that spent too much time
holed up in a gutter and came to believe
it was the center of the world. Once
possessed, it becomes
incredibly self-centered.

Original Text:
【海外留学：かいがいりゅうがく】を【経験：けいけん】して
【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】かぶれになった
【陽気：ようき】なペリカンの【妖怪：ようかい】。
【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】のことはくわしいが
【英語：えいご】は　まったく【話：はな】せない。
Translated Text:
A cheerful pelican-like Yo-kai who
studied abroad and became obsessed
with the U.S. He knows a lot about the

【怪舞伎舞台：かぶきぶたい】の【主演：しゅえん】を【務：つと】める
【妖怪：ようかい】ワールドの【大：だい】スター。
【見：み】た【目：め】の【割：わり】に【気：き】さくな【妖怪：ようかい】だが
【舞台：ぶたい】にあがると【性格：せいかく】が【一変：いっぺん】し
【鬼神：きじん】のごとき【強：つよ】さを【見：み】せる。
まさに　【真打登場：しんうちとうじょう】である。
Translated Text:
The owner who built the Gera Gera Naraku
Resort and the leading star of the Yo-kai
World’s “Mysterious Dance Theater.” He’s
a down-to-earth Yo-kai despite
his appearance, but once he steps
onto the stage, his personality
changes completely, and he displays
strength akin to that of a demon god.
It’s truly the arrival of the headliner.

Original Text:
【脱走不可能：だっそうふかのう】と【言：い】われる【監獄：かんごく】から
４【度：ど】もの【脱走：だっそう】を【成功：せいこう】させた
【妖魔界：ようまかい】の【脱獄王：だつごくおう】。　【脱獄：だつごく】こそが
【最高：さいこう】のゲームだと【考：かんが】えており
ワザと【逮捕：たいほ】されてから
【華麗：かれい】に【脱獄：だつごく】を【決：き】めるのが
この【上：うえ】ない【快感：かいかん】らしい。
【相棒：あいぼう】はサム。
Translated Text:
The "King of Escapes" from the Demon
Realm, who has successfully escaped four
times from a prison said to be impossible
to escape from. He believes that escaping
is the ultimate game, and apparently finds
nothing more exhilarating than getting
himself arrested on purpose just to pull
off a spectacular escape. His
partner is Sam.

Original Text:
【鍛：きた】え【抜：ぬ】かれた【鋼：はがね】のボディに
【乙女：おとめ】のハートをあわせ【持：も】つ
ファイター【妖怪：ようかい】。
その２【本：ほん】の【剛腕：ごうわん】によって
【妖魔界：ようまかい】の【格闘技：かくとうぎ】シーンを
たったの２【日：ふつか】で【統一：とういつ】した。
【休日：きゅうじつ】の【楽：たの】しみは【女子会：じょしかい】トークに
【花：はな】を【咲：さ】かせること。
Translated Text:
A fighter Yo-kai who combines
a well-trained, steel-like body
with the heart of a young girl.
With her two powerful arms, she
unified the martial arts scene of
the Demon Realm in just two days.
On her days off, she enjoys engaging in
lively conversations with her girlfriends.

Original Text:
『【ＵＳＡ：ユーエスエー】』という【外国：がいこく】から
やってきたメリケン【妖怪：ようかい】。
いつか【宇宙：うちゅう】を【旅：たび】するのが【夢：ゆめ】。
【怒：いか】りが【頂点：ちょうてん】に【達：たっ】すると
ベイダーモードに【変身：へんしん】する。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai from a foreign land called “USA.”
His dream is to travel through space
someday. When his
anger reaches its peak, he
transforms into Vader Mode.

Original Text:
【昔：むかし】の【日本：にほん】からやってきた
ネコ【武将：ぶしょう】。
【基本：きほん】　【殿様口調：とのさまくちょう】で【話：はな】す。
ネコの【手：て】によって【天下：てんか】を【治：おさ】める
「【天下布猫：てんかふびょう】」を【目指：めざ】している。
Translated Text:
A cat warlord who came
from ancient Japan.
He generally speaks in the manner
of a feudal lord. His goal is to
achieve “Tenka Fune,” or “ruling
the realm through the power of
cats.”

Original Text:
【異世界：いせかい】・ウタカタの【里：さと】から
やってきたフシギな【生：い】きもの。
【頭：あたま】がよく　【妖怪：ようかい】たちの【言葉：ことば】も
わかるようだ。
しっぽがチャームポイント。
Translated Text:
A mysterious creature from the
otherworldly village of Utakata.
It’s very smart and seems to understand
the language of the Yo-kai. Its
tail is its most charming feature.

Original Text:
さくら【国：こく】を【支配：しはい】する【悪：あく】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
ポジティブで【好戦的：こうせんてき】な【性格：せいかく】で
【妖術：ようじゅつ】と【鋭：するど】いツメが【武器：ぶき】。
【双子：ふたご】の【弟：おとうと】・ソルカと
いつもケンカをして【人間界：にんげんかい】に
【悪影響：あくえいきょう】を【与：あた】えていたため
エンマ【大王：だいおう】の【手：て】によって
『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』に【封印：ふういん】された。
Translated Text:
An evil Yo-kai who rules the
Land of Sakura. He has a
positive yet belligerent personality,
and his weapons are his sorcery
and sharp claws. Because he was
constantly fighting with his
twin brother, Solka, and causing
trouble in the human world, he was
sealed away in *The Three
Kingdoms of Yo-kai* by King Enma.

Original Text:
さくら【国：こく】を【支配：しはい】する【悪：あく】の【妖怪：ようかい】。
ネガティブで【暗：くら】い【性格：せいかく】だが
【目的：もくてき】のためには【手段：しゅだん】を【選：えら】ばない。
【双子：ふたご】の【兄：あに】・ノルカと
いつもケンカをして【人間界：にんげんかい】に
【悪影響：あくえいきょう】を【与：あた】えていたため
エンマ【大王：だいおう】の【手：て】によって
『【妖怪三国志：ようかいさんごくし】』に【封印：ふういん】された。
Translated Text:
An evil Yo-kai who rules
the Land of Sakura.
He has a negative and gloomy
personality, but he’ll stop at
nothing to achieve his goals.
Because he was constantly fighting
with his twin brother, Noruka, and
causing trouble in the human world,
he was sealed away in *The Three
Kingdoms of Yo-kai* by King Enma.

Original Text:
【人間：にんげん】の【争：あらそ】いと【不和：ふわ】の【心：こころ】が
【生：う】み【出：だ】した【巨大妖怪：きょだいようかい】。
【強力：きょうりょく】な【妖術：ようじゅつ】の【数々：かずかず】と
するどいツメや【怪力：かいりき】によって
【相手：あいて】を【粉々：こなごな】に【破壊：はかい】する。
ノルカとソルカの【真：しん】の【姿：すがた】だが
【一度合体：いちどがったい】すると
【元：もと】のふたりには【戻：もど】れない。
Translated Text:
A gigantic Yo-kai born from human
conflict and discord. It shatters its
opponents into pieces using a variety of
powerful magical arts, sharp
claws, and superhuman strength.
It is the true form of Noruka and
Soluka, but once they merge, they
cannot return to their original selves.

Original Text:
【新：あたら】しい【物：もの】や【面白：おもしろ】い【物：もの】を【創造：そうぞう】し
【人々：ひとびと】を【夢中：むちゅう】にさせる【大魔王：だいまおう】。
【自分：じぶん】に【挑：いど】んでくる【英雄：えいゆう】たちが
【大好：だいす】きで　バトル【中：ちゅう】もつねに
【微笑：ほほえ】んでいる。
ちなみに　【周：まわ】りに【浮：う】いている
ゲームは『【三國志：さんごくし】』など
【自：みずか】らが【創造：そうぞう】した【名作：めいさく】の【数々：かずかず】だ。
Translated Text:
A Great Demon King who creates new and
fascinating things and captivates people.
He loves the heroes who challenge
him and is always smiling,
even in the midst of battle.
Incidentally, the games floating
around him are numerous
masterpieces he created himself, such
as *Romance of the Three Kingdoms*.

Original Text:
【大魔王：だいまおう】シブの【力：ちから】によって
【生：う】み【出：だ】された【妖怪：ようかい】。
【目：め】に【装着：そうちゃく】した【宝具：ほうぐ】で
【少：すこ】し【先：さき】の【未来：みらい】を【見通：みとお】し
「【楽：たの】しくなりそうなこと」を
いつもさがしている。
【今：いま】の【楽：たの】しみはみんなと【夜：よ】な【夜：よ】な
パーティーをすること。
Translated Text:
A Yo-kai created by the power of
the Great Demon King Shibu. Using
a magical artifact attached to his
eyes, he can see a little into the future
and is always on the lookout for “things
that look like they’ll be fun.” His
current favorite pastime is throwing
parties with everyone night after night.

Original Text: ぼくを【出：だ】すなんて【不用心：ぶようじん】だねえ。\nいいよ　いっしょに【遊：あそ】ぼう！！
Translated Text:
It's pretty careless of you
to let me out like that.
Okay, let's play together!!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】が【開：あ】けてくれたのか！？\n【今日：きょう】からよろしくなっ！！
Translated Text:
Did you open it for me!? Let's be friends
starting today!!

Original Text: イヤッホーウ！　ありがとう！\nお【礼：れい】だ！　【今日：きょう】からおれたちともだちだっ！
Translated Text:
Yee-haw! Thanks!
Here's a thank-you gift!
Starting today, we're friends!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとう～。\nともだちになろっか～。
Translated Text:
Thanks for sharing that~. Let's be
friends~.

Original Text: そろそろ　このせまい【空間：くうかん】はやめたかった\nのじゃ…。　お【主：ぬし】に【感謝：かんしゃ】するぞ。
Translated Text: It was about time I got out of this\ncramped space… I’m grateful to you.

Original Text: カプセルからはもう【出：で】ん！　と【思：おも】っていたが\nお【主：ぬし】　ワシを【出：だ】したからには【連：つ】れて【行：い】け。
Translated Text: I thought, “I’m never coming out of\nthis capsule!” But since you’ve pulled\nme out, you’d better take me with you.

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとモチ！\nお【前：まえ】の【荷物：にもつ】　【持：も】ってやるモチ！
Translated Text:
Thanks for bringing it out, Mochi!
I'll carry your stuff for you, Mochi!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとモチ！\n【一生：いっしょう】ついていくモチ！
Translated Text:
Thanks for sharing this,
Mochi! I'll follow you
forever, Mochi!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】が　【起：お】こしてくれたとね？\nお【礼：れい】にともだちに　なってやるけん～。
Translated Text:
So you're the one who woke me up?
As a thank-you, I'll be your friend~.

Original Text: ザンバラァ…。　お～　おれを【連：つ】れて【行：い】こう\nって【感：かん】じかぁ？　いいぞぉ～【行：い】くか～。
Translated Text: Zambaraa… Oh~ So you're saying, "Let's\ntake me with you"? Alright then~ Let's go~.

Original Text: ダラァ…！　お？　【開：あ】いたのか！\nよっしゃ　だらけながら【行：い】くかぁ～。
Translated Text:
Ugh...! Oh? It's open!
Alright, I'll just go while being lazy~.

Original Text: このオレを【出：だ】すとは　【勝負：しょうぶ】に【出：で】たな！？\nそのかけ　お【前：まえ】の【勝：か】ちだ！
Translated Text:
You brought out this version of me?
You're really going all out, aren't you!?
On that bet, you win!

Original Text: 【再：ふたた】び【日：ひ】の【光：ひかり】を【浴：あ】びることができるとは…。\nせっしゃはまさむね。　【以後：いご】よろしく【頼：たの】む。
Translated Text:
To think I’d ever see
the light of day again…
I am Masamune. I look forward to
working with you from now on.

Original Text: おお　【外：そと】の【空気：くうき】じゃ！　かたじけない！\nせっしゃ　お【主：ぬし】について【行：い】くでござる！
Translated Text:
Oh! Fresh air! I am most grateful!
I shall follow you, my friend!

Original Text: ほう　オレを【目覚：めざ】めさせたのはお【前：まえ】か…。\nいいだろう。　オレも【参：まい】ろう。
Translated Text:
Oh... So you're the one who woke me up...
Fine. I'll join you, then.

Original Text: むむ！？　【首：くび】から【下：した】がない！？\n【悪：わる】いが【我：われ】と【一緒：いっしょ】に【体：からだ】を【探：さが】してくれんかの。
Translated Text:
Huh!? My body's missing
from the neck down!?
Sorry to ask, but could
you help me look for it?

Original Text: なんじゃ　【家来志願者：けらいしがんしゃ】じゃないのか…。\nまぁよかろう！　さっさと【旅：たび】に【出：で】るぞ！
Translated Text:
"What? You're not applying
to be my servant...?
Oh well, never mind! Let's
get going on this journey!"

Original Text: この【出会：であ】い…　【黄泉：よみ】から【参：まい】った\nかいがあったというものじゃ！
Translated Text: This encounter… It really was worth\ncoming all the way from the underworld!

Original Text: メラァ～　メラメラァ～！\n（【今日：きょう】から　ともだちだ！）
【心：こころ】ふるえたぜ！　サンキューなっ！\n【俺：おれ】とお【前：まえ】は【今：いま】からダチだ！
Translated Text:
That really moved me! Thanks a bunch!
You and I are buddies now!

Original Text: うおおおぉぉおお！！　お【前：まえ】の【気持：きも】ちが\n【轟：とどろ】いたゾォ！！　ついていくぜ！！
Translated Text: Wooooooah!! I can really feel your\npassion!! I'm right behind you!!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとう！　\n【気合：きあ】いがみなぎってきたぜ！
Translated Text:
Thanks for posting this!
I'm feeling totally pumped
now!

Original Text: 【俺：おれ】はもっと【強：つよ】くなるんじゃ！　ここから\n【出：だ】してくれてかんしゃするぞ！
Translated Text: I'm going to get even stronger!\nThanks for getting me out of here!

Original Text: 【戦：たたか】いの【神：かみ】となったわしを【目覚：めざ】めさせたのは\nお【前：まえ】か…。　フフ…　おもしろい！
Translated Text: So it was you who awakened me—the\nGod of War… Huh… How interesting!

Original Text: 【人生：じんせい】で【二度：にど】も【運命：うんめい】の【出会：であ】いをするとはの…。\nわしはお【主：ぬし】にどこまでもついてゆく…！！
Translated Text:
To think I’d have two fateful
encounters in my life…
I’ll follow you wherever you go…!!

Original Text: ふぅ～　ようやく【出：で】られたわ！\n【貴様：きさま】らに　【感謝：かんしゃ】するぞ！
Translated Text:
Phew... I finally made it out!
I'm really grateful to you guys!

Original Text: ここから【出：だ】したのはお【前：まえ】かっ！　くそー！\nむしゃくしゃするほどいいヤツだな！
Translated Text:
"Was it you who let him
out of here?! Damn it!
He's such a great guy it's
enough to drive me crazy!"

Original Text: ここから【出：だ】してくれたおめぇが\n【悪：わる】い【子：こ】なはずねェ。　ともだちなるべ！
Translated Text: You can't be a bad kid if you let\nme out of here. Let's be friends!

Original Text: きみのその【優：やさ】しさで　はなみずを\n【止：と】めてくれるとうれしいな！
Translated Text: I'd be so happy if your kindness\ncould stop my runny nose!

Original Text: かぜうつしちゃってもいいなら\nぼくも【連：つ】れて【行：い】ってよ。　へくしょんっ！
Translated Text: If it's okay if I catch a cold,\ntake me along too. Achoo!

Original Text: あなたが【私：わたし】を【出：だ】してくれること\nわかってた。　【待：ま】ってたわよ！
Translated Text: I knew you'd let me go. I was waiting for it!

Original Text: 【私：わたし】とともだちになりたいんですね。\nうれしいです。　よろしくお【願：ねが】いしますね。
Translated Text:
So you want to be
friends with me, huh? I'm
glad to hear that. I look
forward to getting to know you.

Original Text: オホホホ！　ようやく【外：そと】に【出：で】られました。\n【感謝：かんしゃ】いたしますよ～。
Translated Text:
Oh ho ho ho! I finally
got to go outside. I'm so
grateful~.

Original Text: ぼくは【天才：てんさい】だからね～！\nともだちにしとくと【得：とく】だよ～！　うへへ～。
Translated Text:
I'm a genius, you know!
~ It's worth it to be my friend!~ Hehehe~.

Original Text: ひゃひゃひゃ！　わたしを【出：だ】すなんて！\nあなた【最高：さいこう】ね！　あひゃひゃひゃ！！
Translated Text:
Hahaha! You actually put me in there!
You're the best! Ahahaha!!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがと！　うれしくて\nふるえちゃうわ…。
Translated Text: Thanks for sharing this!\nI'm so happy I'm shaking...

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】が【出：だ】してくれたでござるか！\n【礼：れい】を【申：もう】す！
Translated Text:
Did you bring that out?
I thank you!

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】の【行：おこな】い　かんしゃする！\nあ！　あっぱれなりぃー！
Translated Text:
I appreciate what you've done!
Ah! That's just brilliant!

Original Text: センキュー！　モテモテのボクと\n【付：つ】き【合：あ】って【楽：たの】しいことしようよ！
Translated Text: Thanks! Let's do something fun\ntogether—I'm super popular, after all!

Original Text: ボクがいるとモテまくって\nこまっちゃうかもね～？　それでも【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】？
Translated Text: If I'm around, you might get so\nmuch attention that it'll be a\nhassle, huh? Is that okay with you?

Original Text: だれも【引：ひ】き【当：あ】ててくれないと【思：おも】ってたよ…。\nありがとう　とても【感謝：かんしゃ】している…。
Translated Text:
I didn't think anyone would pick me...
Thank you. I'm so grateful...

Original Text: ババーン！！\n（これから　よろしく【頼：たの】むよ！）
Translated Text:
Ta-da!!
(I'm counting on you from now on!)

Original Text: ババーン！！\n（あんた【幸運：こううん】だね！　【私：わたし】が【出：で】るなんてさ！）
Translated Text:
Ta-da!!
(You're so lucky! Can you
believe I showed up?!)

Original Text: ババーン！！\n（【今日：きょう】から　ここでお【世話：せわ】になるよ！）
Translated Text:
Ta-da!!
(I'll be staying here starting today!)

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】　いい【夢：ゆめ】を【見：み】せてくれそうじゃの。\nついていってやろうかの。
Translated Text:
You seem like you'd give
me some nice dreams.
Maybe I'll go along with you.

Original Text: ぼくをともだちにしてくれたあかつきには\n【毎日：まいにち】いい【夢：ゆめ】をみせてあげる。　どうだい？
Translated Text: If you’ll be my friend, I’ll make\nsure you have sweet dreams\nevery night. How about it?

Original Text: いえーい！　【外：そと】だぜ！　おまえ！\nありがとなーっ！　ともだちなろーぜえ！！
Translated Text:
Yay! We're outside! Hey, you!
Thanks a bunch! Let's be friends!!

Original Text: きみからいい【電波：でんぱ】が【出：で】てる。　その【電波：でんぱ】で\nぼくを【引：ひ】き【当：あ】てた！　これからよろしく！
Translated Text: You're giving off some great vibes.\nThose vibes are what drew me to you!\nLooking forward to getting to know you!

Original Text: やっと【出：で】れた～！　ありがとう。\nこれからいっしょに【電波：でんぱ】　【食：た】べようね～。
Translated Text:
I finally made it out! Thanks.
Let's eat some radio waves
together from now on.

Original Text: ぺろ～ん。　ありがとうございまーす！\nこれから　よろしくおねがいしまーす！
Translated Text:
Lick~. Thank you so much!
I look forward to working
with you from now on!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】　【鏡：かがみ】の【力：ちから】に【興味：きょうみ】はないかい？\nおれといっしょなら【楽：たの】しいぜ…？
Translated Text:
Hey, aren't you interested
in the power of the mirror?
It'd be fun if you came with me…?

Original Text: ほっほ…。　【外：そと】に【出：で】られたのはまぼろしでは\nないのじゃな…？　お【主：ぬし】に【感謝：かんしゃ】するぞい！
Translated Text: Ho ho… So getting outside wasn’t just a\nmirage after all…? I’m truly grateful to you!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれたこと　【礼：れい】を【申：もう】すぞ！\nわしと　ともだちになってみないか？
Translated Text:
I'd like to thank you for letting me out!
How about becoming friends with me?

Original Text: ほうろうの【末：すえ】　【永：なが】らくこのカプセルの【中：なか】に\nおったのじゃ。　お【主：ぬし】かんしゃするぞい！
Translated Text: After all this time, I’ve been\nstuck inside this capsule for\nages. I’m really grateful to you!

Original Text: ハァ　【寒：さむ】かった…。　【出：だ】してくれて\nどうもありがとう。　これからよろしくネ。
Translated Text: Phew, it was cold... Thanks so much\nfor letting me out. I look forward to\nspending time with you from now on.

Original Text: あなた　なかなかいい【顔：かお】してるわね。\nいいわ。　どこへでも【連：つ】れてって。
Translated Text:
You’ve got quite a
handsome face, don’t you? I
like it. Take me anywhere you want.

Original Text: 【私：わたし】を【外：そと】へ【出：だ】して　タダですむと【思：おも】ったら\n【大間違：おおまちが】いじゃぞ！　ともだちになれい！
Translated Text: If you think you can just let me\nout and get away with it, you're\nsorely mistaken! Let's be friends!

Original Text: やっと【出：で】れた…。　きみが【出：だ】したの？\nきみの【言：い】うことを【聞：き】くしかないようだね。
Translated Text:
I finally got out... Did you let me out?
Looks like I have no choice but to do what
you say.

Original Text: わたしを【引：ひ】き【当：あ】てるとは…。\n【奇跡：きせき】だと【思：おも】いなさい…。
Translated Text:
To think you picked me... Just consider it a
miracle...

Original Text: フフフ…。　【私：わたし】を【呼：よ】び【覚：さ】ますとは…\n【後悔：こうかい】することになるぞ…。
Translated Text:
Heh heh heh… To wake
me up… You’re going to
regret this…

Original Text: なんだ～　だりぃなぁ～。　ああ…？\nおれと【行動：こうどう】するのか？　だりぃなぁ…。
Translated Text:
Oh, man... This is such a drag.
Huh...? You're gonna hang out
with me? This is such a drag...

Original Text: トレーニング【中：ちゅう】に【何：なん】の【用：よう】だ？　おお　【旅：たび】か！\n【新：あたら】しい【修行：しゅぎょう】として【悪：わる】くないな！
Translated Text:
What's this all about in the middle of
my training? Oh, a journey! Not a bad
new challenge!

Original Text: 【解放：かいほう】したのはお【前：まえ】か？　よかろう！\nお【前：まえ】をどんな【敵：てき】からも【守：まも】ろう！
Translated Text:
Was it you who set me
free? Very well! I'll protect
you from any enemy!

Original Text: ありがと～！　さっそくだけど\nきみののど　イガイガさせていい？
Translated Text: Thanks!—So, can I make your throat\nfeel a little scratchy right away?

Original Text: ともだちになってくれたら　うれしくて\n【頭痛：あたまいた】くなっちゃうよ！
Translated Text: If you become my friend, I'll be so\nhappy it'll give me a headache!

Original Text: 【服：ふく】のセンスにあなたが【出：で】てるわね。\nあなた　すてきね…　ともだちになって！
Translated Text:
Your sense of style really shows.
You're so cute... Let's be friends!

Original Text: おっしゃれ～！　ステキな【場所：ばしょ】ね。\n【決：き】めた！　【今日：きょう】からここで【暮：く】らすわ！
Translated Text:
So stylish! What a wonderful place. It's
decided! I'm going to
live here starting today!

Original Text: あなた　とてもきれいな【骨：ほね】してるわ！\nもっとよく【見：み】せてちょうだい！
Translated Text:
You have such beautiful
bones! Let me take a
closer look!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】と　ともだちになるって【決：き】めた！\nきょひはムリだからな！
Translated Text:
I've decided to be friends
with you! There's no
way I'm going to refuse!

Original Text: ここから【出：で】るのはムリだと【思：おも】ってたじょー！\nかんしゃするじょー！
Translated Text:
I thought there was no way
I'd make it out of here! I'm so
grateful!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれた【礼：れい】だ。\nお【前：まえ】の【命：いのち】　このシロカベが【守：まも】ってやるぞ！
Translated Text:
This is my way of thanking
you for saving me.
I, Shirokabe, will protect your life!

Original Text: ともだちになってくれるまでここを【通：とお】さん！\nもう【一度言：いちどい】う！　【通：とお】しはせんぞ！
Translated Text:
I won't let you through here until
you become my friend! I'll say it
again! I won't let you through!

Original Text: おれは　お【前：まえ】とともだちになるんだ！\nともだちになってくれるまで【絶対：ぜったい】に【通：とお】さん！
Translated Text:
"I'm going to be friends with you! I won't
let you pass until you agree to be my
friend!"

Original Text: きみが　ボクを【見：み】つけてくれたのか！\nいっしょに　【探：さが】し【物：もの】を【手伝：てつだ】ってくれ！
Translated Text:
So you found me!
Help me look for it!

Original Text: ややっ　【今：いま】　【中：なか】でけいこをしておった【所：ところ】だ。\nさあ　お【主：ぬし】も　いっしょにけいこじゃ！
Translated Text:
Oh, hey! I was just practicing in there.
Come on, you should join me!

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】のようなやつを【待：ま】っておった！\n【世界一強：せかいいちつよ】くなりたいのじゃ！　【協力：きょうりょく】せい！
Translated Text:
I've been waiting for
someone just like you!
I want to become the strongest
in the world! Help me!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】のおこない　【礼：れい】を【言：い】うぜ！　【代：か】わりに\nこのオレがともだちになってやろう！
Translated Text: I'll give you credit for what you've\ndone! In return, I'll be your friend!

Original Text: このままでは【体：からだ】がなまってしまうところ\nだったわい！　お【主：ぬし】　かんしゃするぞ！
Translated Text: If things had gone on like this,\nI would’ve gotten out of shape!\nI’m really grateful to you!

Original Text: おぬしとわしは【一心同体：いっしんどうたい】。　ともだちじゃ！\nわしは【強：つよ】さならだれにも【負：ま】けぬぞ！？
Translated Text:
You and I are one and
the same. We're friends!
When it comes to strength,
I'm second to none!

Original Text: 【一番：いちばん】をキープし【続：つづ】けるから　【一番：いちばん】なのじゃ。\n【一番：いちばん】でありたいなら　わしを【連：つ】れてけ！
Translated Text:
It’s the number one because
it keeps staying number one.
If you want to be number
one, take me with you!

Original Text: 【銅：どう】は【強：つよ】くたくましい。　【明日：あした】は【今日：きょう】より\nすばらしい【日：ひ】にすべく　わしを【連：つ】れて【行：い】け！
Translated Text: Copper is strong and resilient. Take\nme with you so that tomorrow will\nbe an even better day than today!

Original Text: 【銀：ぎん】というのは　まだまだ【上：うえ】を【目指：めざ】す【力：ちから】を\n【持：も】っているということじゃ！　【友：とも】となろう！
Translated Text: Silver means you still have the potential\nto aim even higher! Let's be friends!

Original Text: む…　お【主：ぬし】　【心：こころ】の【底：そこ】にプラチナ【級：きゅう】の【輝：かがや】きを\nひめておるな？　ともだちになろうぞ！
Translated Text: Hmm... You've got a platinum-level\nsparkle hidden deep in your\nheart, don't you? Let's be friends!

Original Text: カプセルの【中：なか】　【意外：いがい】と【快適：かいてき】だったよぉ。\nきみも【一回入：いっかいはい】ってみれば？
Translated Text:
Inside the capsule... it was actually
pretty comfortable. Why don't
you give it a try sometime?

Original Text: 【海：うみ】より【広：ひろ】い【心：こころ】を【感：かん】じるよぉ…。\nきみ　ただ【者：もの】じゃないねぇ？
Translated Text:
I can feel a heart as vast as the ocean...
You're no ordinary person, are you?

Original Text: お【前：まえ】　いいくじ【運：うん】を【持：も】ってるミーン！\nともだちになろうミーン！
Translated Text:
Man, you've got great luck
with the lottery! Let's be
friends!

Original Text: おれを【出：だ】すたぁ　お【前：まえ】やるな！\nともだちになるぜ！
Translated Text:
"You got me! You're pretty good! Let's be
friends!"

Original Text: ありがとう！　さっそくともだちになろう。\n【美声：びせい】の【僕：ぼく】に【酔：よ】いしれちゃいな。
Translated Text:
Thanks! Let's be friends right away.
Just let yourself be swept
away by my beautiful voice.

Original Text: あたしなんかが【出：で】て　トホホと【思：おも】った？\nトホホ…　それでもついていくよ…。
Translated Text:
Did you think, "Oh no, here
I am," when I showed up?
Oh no... Well, I'll stick with you anyway...

Original Text: その…　カッコウは【悪：わる】いけど\n【性格：せいかく】は【悪：わる】くないと【思：おも】うから…　よろしく…。
Translated Text: Well... I know I'm not exactly the most\nattractive person, but I don't think I'm\na bad person... So, nice to meet you...

Original Text: ありがとう…　ついていくよ…。\nずーっとずーっと　【死：し】ぬまで　ね。
Translated Text:
Thank you… I’ll follow you…
Forever and ever, until the day I die.

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとニャ\nお【礼：れい】にともだちになってやるニャ！
Translated Text: Thanks for letting me out, meow! As a\nthank-you, I'll be your friend, meow!

Original Text: Ｓ【級：きゅう】なオレっちのお【出：で】ましニャー！\n【頭：ず】が【高：たか】いニャ～。
Translated Text:
Here comes me, the S-Class cat! I hold my
head high, meow~.

Original Text: ニャー！！　シャバの【空気：くうき】ニャー！\nお【前：まえ】ありがとニャン！
Translated Text:
Meow!! The fresh air of
the outside world, meow!
Thanks a bunch, meow!

Original Text: オレを【出：だ】すなんていい【度胸：どきょう】してるニャ！\n【気：き】に【入：い】ったニャ！　ついて【行：い】ってやるニャ！
Translated Text:
You've got some nerve
putting me out there, meow! I
like that, meow! I'll go with you, meow!

Original Text: ワープすれば　いつでも【出：で】られたんだがな\nきみが【来：く】るのをまっていたのだ！
Translated Text: I could have left anytime by warping,\nbut I was waiting for you to come!

Original Text: きみの　【輝：かがや】きはすばらしい\n【私：わたし】にも　【負：ま】けないぐらいだ！
Translated Text: Your radiance is amazing—it's\njust as brilliant as mine!

Original Text: きみの【目：め】　キラキラと【輝：かがや】いてるニャ！\nそう！　ダイヤモンドのようニャン！
Translated Text:
Your eyes are sparkling, meow! That's
right! Just like diamonds, meow!

Original Text: やっぱり【外：そと】はいいニャンね～。\nこれからよろしくニャン！
Translated Text:
It really is nice out here, meow~.
Looking forward to hanging out with you
from now on, meow!

Original Text: きみの【心：こころ】　キラキラしてるニャ！\nエメラルド【級：きゅう】ニャン！
Translated Text:
Your heart is sparkling, meow! It's
emerald-class, meow!

Original Text: フニャー！　ニャンだ【外：そと】かニャ。\nこれからよろしくニャ～！
Translated Text:
Meow! Is this outside?
Nice to meet you!

Original Text: ニャァ～　【気持：きも】ちよく【寝：ね】てたのに…。\nまぁ…　これからよろしくニャ。
Translated Text:
Meow~ I was sleeping so soundly...
Oh well... Nice to meet you, meow.

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとっスー。\nいっしょに　おにぎり【食：た】べるっス！
Translated Text:
Thanks for bringing it out,
man. Let's eat some rice balls
together!

Original Text: おお！　きみが【出：だ】してくれたのか！\n【主：あるじ】と【認：みと】めよう！　これからよろしく【頼：たの】む！
Translated Text:
Wow! So you're the one who brought
this out! I'll acknowledge you as my
master! I'm counting on you from now on!

Original Text: この【気持：きも】ち！　サーフィンの【時：とき】みたいに\nワクワクしてる！　これからよろしくな！
Translated Text: This feeling! I'm so excited—just\nlike when I'm surfing! Looking\nforward to working with you!

Original Text: もんげぇーーーーっ！\n【助：たす】かったズラ！
コマさん【探：さが】していたら　きみに【会：あ】えたズラ！\nともだちになってほしいズラ！
Translated Text:
I was looking for Komasan, and then
I ran into you! I'd love for us to be
friends!

Original Text: ここは　もんげー【都会：とかい】ズラね…。\nちゃんとなじめるか【心配：しんぱい】ズラ…。
Translated Text:
This place is such a big-city vibe, huh...
I'm worried if I'll be able to fit in here...

Original Text: 【兄：にい】ちゃん【見：み】てないズラ？\nカプセルに【入：い】れられてはぐれちゃったズラ。
Translated Text:
Didn't you see me, big bro? I got put in a
capsule and got separated from the group.

Original Text: 【最高：さいこう】の【宿主：やどぬし】…　こんな【形：かたち】で【出会：であ】えるとは…。\nおれはあんたに　【忠誠：ちゅうせい】をちかうぜ！
Translated Text:
The ultimate host… I never
imagined we’d meet like this…
I swear my loyalty to you!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】との【出会：であ】いを【待：ま】っていた！\nともだちになるしかねぇぜ！
Translated Text:
I've been waiting to meet
you! We've got to be
friends!

Original Text: ぼ～…　ハッ！　【外：そと】だ！　いま【気：き】が【付：つ】いた。\nきみが【出：だ】してくれたの？　ありがとう！
Translated Text:
Hmm... Oh! It's outside! I just noticed. Did
you put it out there? Thanks!

Original Text: えっと…　その　あの…　ありがと…。\nもう　ともだち…？　だよね？
Translated Text:
Um... well... uh... thanks...
Are we friends now...? Right?

Original Text: 【寒：さむ】かったですぅー。\n【早：はや】く！　あたたかい【場所：ばしょ】に【行：い】きましょう！
Translated Text:
It was sooo cold.
Hurry up! Let's go somewhere warm!

Original Text: 【寒：さむ】いのはきらいか？\nいっしょにアツい【戦：たたか】いをしよう！
Translated Text:
Don't like the cold? Let's fight it out
together!

Original Text: 【友情：ゆうじょう】！　【努力：どりょく】！　【勝利：しょうり】！\nおれは　お【前：まえ】に【全：すべ】てをもたらすぜ！！
Translated Text:
Friendship! Hard Work! Victory!
I'm going to bring you it all!!

Original Text: も…　もれちゃう！　もれちゃうから\n【早：はや】くともだちになって！！
Translated Text: It's... going to spill! It's going to\nspill, so let's be friends already!!

Original Text: プルプル…。　【早：はや】くしないと\nもれちゃうから　ともだちになって！
Translated Text: Wobble, wobble... If you don't\nhurry, it'll spill, so let's be friends!

Original Text: わしを【当：あ】てるとは　お【主：ぬし】なかなかの\nきまぐれ【者：もの】じゃな？
Translated Text: To have guessed it—you’re quite\nthe capricious one, aren’t you?

Original Text: お【主：ぬし】との【特別：とくべつ】な【運命：うんめい】を【感：かん】じるぞ！\n【数奇：すうき】な【人生：じんせい】を【送：おく】れそうじゃのう！
Translated Text:
I sense a special destiny with you!
It looks like we’re in for quite an
eventful life!

Original Text: 【貴様：きさま】か　オレを【外：そと】に【出：だ】したやつは。\n【感謝：かんしゃ】してやるぞ。
Translated Text:
So it's you—the one who let
me out. I'll show you some
gratitude.

Original Text: 【貴様：きさま】…　オレを【出：だ】すとはなかなかやるな。\nいいだろう　ついて【行：い】ってやろう！
Translated Text:
You... You're pretty bold
to bring me out like that.
Fine, I'll go with you!

Original Text: ずーっと　ひもじかったわい。\nこれからあんたが【恵：めぐ】んでくれるのかのう？
Translated Text:
I've been starving for ages.
I wonder if you're going to give
me something to eat now?

Original Text: 【米：こめ】は【好：す】きかのう？　【好：す】きならわれらは\nもうともだちじゃ！
Translated Text: Do you like rice? If you do,\nthen we're already friends!

Original Text: うほほ！　【外：そと】じゃ！　メシを【食：く】うのじゃ！\nん…？　お【前：まえ】　うまそうじゃな…！
Translated Text:
Whoo-hoo! We're outside! Time to eat!
Hmm...? You look pretty tasty, don't you...!

Original Text: もう…　こんな【所：ところ】にとじこめられて\nサイアクですよ…　まったく…。
Translated Text: Seriously... Being cooped up in a\nplace like this is the worst... Really...

Original Text: なあ　【俺：おれ】たち【二人：ふたり】で【一人：ひとり】。\nな？　【他：ほか】のヤツよりお【得：とく】だろ！？
Translated Text:
Hey, the two of us are like one person.
Right? That's a better deal
than the others, isn't it!?

Original Text: お【前：まえ】　おれらを【見：み】てもこわくねえのか？\nハハッ　【気：き】に【入：い】ったぜ！　ともだちだ！
Translated Text:
You... aren't you scared when you see us?
Hahaha! I like you! You're my friend!

Original Text: ゲ・キ・ウ・ケ～！\n【外：そと】に【出：で】られて　【笑：わら】いが【止：と】まりません～。
Translated Text:
This is so hilarious!
Now that I'm outside, I can't stop laughing!

Original Text: フン♪フフン♪　あれ　【聞：き】いてたの？\n【僕：ぼく】といっしょに　デュエットしようよ♪
Translated Text:
Hum♪ Hmm-hum♪ Oh, were you listening?
Let's sing a duet together♪

Original Text: ツボだけじゃなくて　カプセルにまで\n【入：い】れられるとはなぁ！　シャシャシャ！
Translated Text: I can't believe they can even put it in\ncapsules—not just in vials! Ha ha ha!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれて　ありがとう！\n【今日：きょう】からきみも　【絶好調：ぜっこうちょう】だよ！
Translated Text:
Thanks for sharing!
Starting today, you're in top form, too!

Original Text: あんなカプセルとはもう【絶交：ぜっこう】だ！\nこれからは　きみとともだちになるぞ！
Translated Text:
I'm done with that capsule!
From now on, I'm going
to be friends with you!

Original Text: いま　わたくしの【気分：きぶん】は【最高：さいこう】よ！\nわたくしがいれば　あなたも【最高潮：さいこうちょう】よ！
Translated Text:
Right now, I'm feeling great!
With me around, you'll be
on top of the world too!

Original Text: あら　あなたが【出：だ】してくれたのね。　\nアゲアゲでいくわよ～！
Translated Text:
Oh, so you're the one who put this out
. Let's get this party started!

Original Text: そのステップ　きみもおどるんだね！？\nもうボクらは　ダンスともだちだ！！
Translated Text:
That step—you’re dancing
it too, aren’t you!? We’re
already dance buddies!!

Original Text: 【今：いま】まで　ずーっとおどっていたんです。\nさあ　いっしょにおどりましょう！
Translated Text:
I've been dancing the whole time.
Come on, let's dance together!

Original Text: あーん！　サビのいいところだったのにぃ！\nダンスを【止：と】めた【罰：ばつ】としていっしょにおどろ！
Translated Text:
Aww! That was the best part of the
chorus! As punishment for stopping the
dance, you have to dance with me!

Original Text: 【開：あ】けてくれてキュンとしたよぉ～。\nきみのこともキュンとさせてあげるね。
Translated Text:
My heart skipped a beat
when you opened it~.
I'll make your heart skip a beat, too.

Original Text: ズキュキュキュン！　【運命感：うんめいかん】じちゃった！\nこれからよろしくね！　ズキュキュキュン！
Translated Text:
Thump-thump-thump! I just felt destiny!
Let's get to know each other from
now on! Thump-thump-thump!

Original Text: 【運命感：うんめいかん】じちゃう？　ぼくは【感：かん】じたよ！\nな～んてね。
Translated Text:
Do you feel like it's fate? I sure did!
Just kidding.

Original Text: ハ～　やさしい【時間：じかん】だったボーノ！\nこれからはきみと【旅：たび】するボーノ！
Translated Text:
Ahh... That was such a
peaceful time, Bono!
From now on, I'll be
traveling with you, Bono!

Original Text: やっぱり【外：そと】は【気持：きも】ちがいいねぇ～。\nずっとこの【気分：きぶん】でいられるといいな～。
Translated Text:
It really is nice out here, isn't it? I
wish I could stay feeling like this
forever.

Original Text: あーあ…　【最近：さいきん】つまらない…\nと【思：おも】ってたけど　あなたに【出会：であ】えて【最高：さいこう】！
Translated Text:
Oh man… I’ve been thinking things
have been kind of boring lately…
but meeting you has been the best!

Original Text: ほっほっほ！　プレゼントをひとつやろう\nそれは　わしじゃ！　ほっほっほ！
Translated Text: Ho ho ho! I'll give you a\npresent. It's me! Ho ho ho!

Original Text: わしがいれば　【毎日：まいにち】プレゼントを\nもらうより【楽：たの】しいぞい！　ほっほっほ！
Translated Text: With me around, it's way more fun than\ngetting a present every day! Ho ho ho!

Original Text: あらあら、あなた【若：わか】いのにりっぱねぇ。\nおともだちになってくれるかしら？
Translated Text:
Oh my, you're so young, yet so
impressive. Would you like to be my
friend?

Original Text: ふぉっふぉっふぉ…。　ありがとうねぇ。\nわしの【孫：まご】にならんか？
Translated Text:
Heh heh heh… Thanks a lot.
Why don’t you become my grandchild?

Original Text: ふむ！　わしがお【前：まえ】のともだちになって\nビシビシきたえてやろう！　ハッハッハ！
Translated Text: Hmm! I'll become your friend and really\nput you through your paces! Ha ha ha!

Original Text: わしを【連：つ】れて【行：い】け！\nまだまだ【若：わか】いもんには【負：ま】けんぞ！
Translated Text:
Take me with you!
I'm not about to let the
young ones beat me just yet!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】がおいらを【出：だ】したのか？　けっ！\nやるじゃねえか！　ともだちになるぞ！
Translated Text:
Did you summon me? Hah!
Not bad! Let's be friends!

Original Text: こらせがいのありそうな\nいい【肩：かた】してるじゃねぇか！　【気：き】に【入：い】ったぜ！
Translated Text: Hey, look at those shoulders—they look\nlike they’d be a lot of fun! I like what I see!

Original Text: じっとしすぎて　【腰：こし】を【痛：いた】めるとこだったぜ！\n【出：だ】してくれてありがとな！
Translated Text:
I was sitting still for so
long I almost hurt my back!
Thanks for letting me out!

Original Text: もう【一生：いっしょう】あそこから【出：で】られないと\n【思：おも】ってたブーン。　ともだちになるブーン。
Translated Text: Boom, who thought he’d never\nget out of there for the rest of his\nlife. Boom, who becomes a friend.

Original Text: はぁーぁ　【中：なか】にいても【外：そと】に【出：で】てもゆううつ…\nあんたと　ともだちになるしかないブーン。
Translated Text:
Sigh... Whether I'm inside or
outside, I feel so down... I guess
I'll just have to be friends with
you, Boon.

Original Text: あたしを【出：だ】した【時：とき】から　【肌：はだ】がかゆくない？\nもし【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】なら　ともだちブーン！
Translated Text:
Has your skin been itchy since I left?
If you're okay with it, let's be friends!

Original Text: ともだちになろうよ！　【楽：たの】しいところへ\nみちびいてあげるよ！
Translated Text: Let's be friends! I'll take\nyou to some fun places!

Original Text: きみが【出：だ】してくれたの？　ぼくが【先生：せんせい】なら\nえこひいきしているとこだよ。
Translated Text: Did you hand that in? If I were the\nteacher, I’d be playing favorites.

Original Text: きみの【優：やさ】しさを【横取：よこど】りしたい！\nできないから　いっしょにつれてって！
Translated Text:
I want to steal your kindness!
But since I can't, take me with you!

Original Text: いっしょに【腹：はら】おどりしようヨ～。\nヨ～！　あ　ポン！　あ　ポン！
Translated Text:
Let's belly dance together~.
Yo~! Ah, pon! Ah, pon!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してもらわなくても【出：で】れたけどね！\n【私：わたし】とともだちになったら　あんた【最強：さいきょう】だよ？
Translated Text:
I could've gotten out without
you helping me, though!
If you become my friend,
you'll be the best, right?

Original Text: あなたどうもありがとう！　あなたなら\n【私：わたし】のお【気：き】に【入：い】りに【入：い】れてあげてもいいわよ？
Translated Text: Thank you so much! I might just\nadd you to my favorites, you know?

Original Text: ふ～　やっぱシャバの【空気：くうき】が【一番：いちばん】ダゼ！\nなぁ　おめえ　おれとダチになろうぜ～？
Translated Text:
Phew... The air on the
outside is the best, man!
Hey, you—wanna be my buddy?

Original Text: 【久：ひさ】しぶりのシャバの【空気：くうき】。　【手間：てま】かけたな。\nこの【恩：おん】　【俺：おれ】は【一生：いっしょう】かけて【返：かえ】していくぜ！
Translated Text:
It’s been a while since I’ve breathed
the air of the outside world. You
really went out of your way for me.
I’ll spend the rest of my life
paying you back for this favor!

Original Text: おめぇ　サンキュな。\n【俺：おれ】たちもうダチだな！
【魔：ま】がさして　カプセルに【入：はい】ったら\nこんなことに…。　【出：で】れてよかったぜ…。
Translated Text: I got carried away and went into\nthe capsule, and this is what\nhappened... Glad I made it out...

Original Text: やっと【外：そと】に【出：で】れた…。\nともだちになろ！　ウー【魔：ま】！
Translated Text:
I finally made it outside... Let's be
friends! Woo-ma!

Original Text: わしを【連：つ】れて【行：い】かぬか？\n【若：わか】さをうらんだりはせんよ…。　ふふふ…。
Translated Text:
Won't you take me with you? I
won't begrudge you your youth
... Heh heh heh...

Original Text: あらあなた　【若々：わかわか】しいわねえ。\nちょっとだけ　【命：いのち】すわせてくれない？
Translated Text:
Oh, you look so young.
Could you let me borrow a
little bit of your life?

Original Text: わたしも【連：つ】れて【行：い】ってちょうだい。\n【不死身：ふじみ】の【秘密教：ひみつおし】えてあげる。
Translated Text:
Please take me with you,
too. I'll tell you the secret to
immortality.

Original Text: お【前：まえ】　ありがとう…　プゥー…。\nしまった…　へ　が【出：で】た…。
Translated Text:
Thanks, you... Phew...
Oops... I let out a "he"...

Original Text: プゥー…。　せまいカプセルの【中：なか】で\n【死：し】ぬかと【思：おも】ったー。　プゥー…。
Translated Text: Phew... I thought I was going to\ndie in that tiny capsule. Phew...

Original Text: アンタとはうまくやっていけるカモノハシ！\nだっはっは！　【今：いま】のおもしろかった？
Translated Text:
I think I'll get along
great with you, Platypus!
Ha ha ha! Was that funny?

Original Text: ワシがいれば　【最強：さいきょう】だわんこそば！\nふはは！　【今：いま】のダジャレってわかった？
Translated Text:
With me around, Wanko
Soba is unbeatable!
Hahaha! Did you get that pun?

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとう！\n【楽：たの】しすぎてねむれなくなっちゃいそう！
Translated Text:
Thanks for sharing this!
It's so much fun, I don't
think I'll be able to sleep!

Original Text: あなたが【出：だ】してくれたのね…。\nありがとう…　いい【夢：ゆめ】みせてあげるわ。
Translated Text:
So you were the one who gave it to me...
Thank you... I'll give you a nice dream.

Original Text: こんな【地味：じみ】な\nボクを【見：み】つけるなんて　【感謝：かんしゃ】です…。
Translated Text: I'm so grateful you found\nsomeone as plain as me...

Original Text: せっしゃ　このご【恩：おん】を【忘：わす】れないでござる。\nお【主：ぬし】にお【仕：つか】えいたそう！
Translated Text:
I shall never forget this kindness.
I shall serve you faithfully!

Original Text: やっと【気：き】づいて【出：だ】してもらえた…。\nせっしゃの【友：とも】となってくれるか…？
Translated Text:
I finally realized it and got
them to let me out... Will you be
my friend...?

Original Text: はー　じめじめしてたぁ。\nともだちになってくれる？
Translated Text:
Whew... it was so muggy.
Want to be friends?

Original Text: ジュースの【氷：こおり】たべる【派：は】？　だったら\nもうぼくら　ともだちだよ！
Translated Text: Do you like eating the ice cubes in your\njuice? If so, then we're already friends!

Original Text: 【鼻血：はなぢ】よくでる？　【出：で】るんならうれしいなぁ。\nこれからよろしく。
Translated Text:
Do you get nosebleeds often? If
so, that makes me happy. I look
forward to getting to know you.

Original Text: ともだちなろ～。　【天気：てんき】は【変：か】わりやすいけど\nぼくのきもちは【変：か】わらないぞ～。
Translated Text: Let's be friends! The weather may\nchange, but my feelings won't.

Original Text: ぼくといれば　【夏：なつ】だってすずしいよ～！\nだから　ぼくも【連：つ】れて【行：い】って！
Translated Text:
If you're with me, even summer feels cool!
So please take me with you!

Original Text: あなたがここから【解放：かいほう】してくれたのね\nジュヴァ～ン！　もうともだちね！
Translated Text: So you're the one who set me free\nfrom here, Juvan! We're friends now!

Original Text: きみのくじ【運：うん】　うらやまスィー！\nボクと　ともだちになってください！
Translated Text:
You're so lucky!
I'm so jealous! Please be my friend!

Original Text: 【今度：こんど】　きみの【家：いえ】に【遊：あそ】びに【行：い】ってもいい？\nちょうど【夕飯：ゆうはん】の【前：まえ】にさ！
Translated Text:
Can I come over to your place sometime?
Right before dinner!

Original Text: カプセルにひきこもってたのに…。\nともだちにしてくれますか…？
Translated Text:
Even though I was holed up in
my capsule... Would you be my
friend...?

Original Text: カプセルに【閉：と】じこもってたんですが…。\n【今日：きょう】からここで【閉：と】じこもっていいですか？
Translated Text:
I was holed up in a capsule, but... Is it
okay if I stay holed up here starting
today?

Original Text: カプセル…。　【私：わたし】の【家：いえ】が…。\n【新：あたら】しいお【家：うち】さがしてくれますか？
Translated Text:
Capsule... My home...
Can you help me find a new home?

Original Text: あははは！　きみみたいな【子：こ】に\n【出：だ】してもらえて【幸：しあわ】せー！　ともだちなろー！
Translated Text: Hahaha! I'm so happy someone like\nyou sent me this! Let's be friends!

Original Text: これからよろしくなー！\nおっと　【小銭落：こぜにお】としたよ！
Translated Text:
Let's get along well from now on!
Oops, I dropped some change!

Original Text: ど～ぅせ　ぼくなんかが【出：で】て\nがっかりしてるんだろ？　はぁ～あ…。
Translated Text: "You're probably just disappointed\nthat it's me, aren't you? Sigh..."

Original Text: 【本：ほん】を【読：よ】むより【楽：たの】しいこと\n【教：おし】えてよ…。
Translated Text: Tell me something more\nfun than reading a book…

Original Text: 【本当：ほんとう】にともだちになってくれる？\n【本当：ほんとう】？　【本当：ほんとう】に【本当：ほんとう】？
Translated Text:
Will you really be my friend?
Really? Are you really, really serious?

Original Text: 【別：べつ】に【出：で】れなかったわけじゃねーし！\n【責任：せきにん】とれよ～！
Translated Text:
It's not like I couldn't get out or anything!
Take responsibility, will you?!

Original Text: ともだちになってほしいのぉ～？\nどぉ～しよっかなぁ～。
Translated Text:
Do you want to be my
friend? Hmm... I wonder
what I should do...

Original Text: いきなり【開：あ】けるなよ！\nビビったじゃねーかよ！
Translated Text:
Don't just open it out of the blue! You
scared the hell out of me!

Original Text: フン　お【前：まえ】のような【雑魚：ざこ】ごときが\nともだちなど…！　なってもいいけど…。
Translated Text: Hmph. As if a nobody like you\ncould ever be my friend…! Well,\nI guess I could let you be…

Original Text: 【虫歯：むしば】になるか　オレを【仲間：なかま】にするか\nどっちか【選：えら】ばせてやる。
Translated Text: I'll let you choose: either get a\ncavity or let me join your group.

Original Text: ともだちになるかのぅ？\n【高：たか】くつくぞ…。
Translated Text:
Wanna be friends?
It's gonna cost you...

Original Text: そなたからは　【闇：やみ】の【力：ちから】を【感：かん】じるぞ…。\n【闇：やみ】が　われらを【引：ひ】き【合：あ】わせた…！
Translated Text:
I sense the power of
darkness coming from you...
The darkness is what
brought us together...!

Original Text: NULL
あっ　【見：み】つかっちゃった！\nきみ【幸運：こううん】だね！
Translated Text:
Oh, you got caught!
You're lucky!

Original Text: わぁ　ここにいるってわかってた？\nきみラッキーだなぁ。
Translated Text:
Wow! Did you know I was here?
You're so lucky.

Original Text: あなたに【見：み】つかるの\n【期待：きたい】してのです…。
お【前：まえ】が【出：だ】してくれたのか！？\nありがとうなのだ。　よろしくなのだ。
Translated Text:
Did you give this to me!?
Thank you so much. Nice to meet you.

Original Text: われは　お【前：まえ】について【行：い】くことに【決：き】めたぞ！\n【心：こころ】しておけよ！
Translated Text:
I've decided to go with you!
You better be ready!

Original Text: そなたの【清：きよ】らかな【心：こころ】が【引：ひ】き【当：あ】てたのじゃな！\nよろしい。　【仲間：なかま】になろう。
Translated Text:
It was your pure heart that
drew this upon you! Very
well. Let’s become allies.

Original Text: お【前：まえ】みたいなやつ　【大：だい】っ【嫌：きら】いだー！\nこれからはともだちだけどなー！
Translated Text:
I really hate people like you!
But we're friends from now on, though!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】のこと　【一生：いっしょう】うらんでやるー！\nだから　ずっといっしょにいてもいいか？
Translated Text:
I'm going to resent you
for the rest of my life!
So... can we stay together forever?

Original Text: なんで【出：だ】したんだよ！　くそー！\n【仲間：なかま】にしてくれ！
Translated Text:
Why did you let him out?! Dammit!
Let me join your team!

Original Text: ありがとな！　これから\nいっしょに【道草食：みちくさく】おうぜ！
Translated Text: Thanks! Let's take our time and enjoy\nthe journey together from here on out!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとな！\nところでお【前：まえ】の【得意：とくい】なことはなんだ？
Translated Text:
Thanks for letting me out!
By the way, what are you good at?

Original Text: シェッシェッシェ！\n【今日：きょう】はパーっとお【祝：いわ】いしよっか！
Translated Text:
Heh, heh, heh! Let's celebrate in style
today!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれたんだね！\nきみのこと　お【金：かね】の【次：つぎ】にすきだよ！
Translated Text:
So you bought it for me!
You're my second favorite
thing after money!

Original Text: ここから【出：だ】してくれたってことは\nワイと【語：かた】り【合：あ】いたいってことやな！？
Translated Text: If you let me out of here, that means\nyou want to talk with me, right!?

Original Text: ナガバナちゃうで　ナガバナナやで。\n【今日：きょう】からよろしゅう【頼：たの】んます。
Translated Text:
It's not "Nagabana"—it's "Naganana." I
look forward to working with you starting
today.

Original Text: まことに　あっぱれなり！\nともだちになるんジャ！
Translated Text:
That's truly amazing! Let's be
friends!

Original Text: そなたの【堂々：どうどう】とした【出：い】で【立：た】ち　【見事：みごと】じゃ！\n【仲間：なかま】にしてくれ！
Translated Text:
Your dignified demeanor
is truly impressive!
Let me join your group!

Original Text: 【別：べつ】に【外：そと】になんか【出：で】たくなかったけど\n【仕方：しかた】ないから　ついて【行：い】ってやるよ…。
Translated Text: I didn't really want to go out or\nanything, but I guess I have no\nchoice, so I'll go along with you...

Original Text: 【私：わたし】が　こんなやつに【救：すく】われるなんてな…。\nお【前：まえ】を【認：みと】めよう…。
Translated Text:
Who would've thought I'd be saved by a
guy like this... I guess I'll have to admit
you're something...

Original Text: そなたの【目：め】…。　【相当：そうとう】な【強：つよ】い【心：こころ】…。\n【気：き】に【入：い】った。　ついて【行：い】こう。
Translated Text:
Your eyes... You have a
remarkably strong spirit... I
like that. I'll follow you.

Original Text: クッ！　【外：そと】の【世界：せかい】はなんてまぶしいんだッ！\nオレも【負：ま】けずにかがやくぜッ！
Translated Text:
Whoa! The outside world is so bright!
I'm gonna shine just as bright as it does!

Original Text: それがし　ブシニャンでござる！\nお【主：ぬし】の　【友：とも】となるでござる！
Translated Text:
I am Bushinyan!
I shall be your friend!

Original Text: しゅらコマだぜ～！\nともだちなるぜ～！
Translated Text:
It's Shura Koma! Let's be
friends!

Original Text: ワンダホー！　イケメンの【登場：とうじょう】さ！\n【夢中：むちゅう】にさせて　あげるよ！
Translated Text:
Wonderful! Here comes a hottie!
I'm going to make you fall head over heels!

Original Text: わしといっしょに\nこの【町：まち】を【花：はな】でいっぱいにせんか？
Translated Text: Why don't you join me in\nfilling this town with flowers?

Original Text: 【我：われ】は【鬼：おに】！\nお【前：まえ】はともだち！
Translated Text:
I'm a demon!
You're my friend!

Original Text: ううう…　せまかったです…。\nこれからはキミと【一緒：いっしょ】がいいです！
Translated Text:
Ugh... That was tight...
From now on, I want to be with you!

Original Text: かたじけない！\nおそうじで【恩返：おんがえ】しするでござる！
Translated Text:
I’m so grateful!
I’ll repay your kindness by cleaning!

Original Text: 【出：だ】してなんて【言：い】ってないもん！\nおこった！　ボクもついていく！
Translated Text:
I never said to let me out! I'm
mad! I'm coming with you!

Original Text: 【鬼：おに】のにおい…。　【出番：でばん】がきたようだな！\nよし！　お【主：ぬし】と【共：とも】に【行：い】かせてくれ！
Translated Text:
The scent of a demon…
Looks like it's my turn!
All right! Let me go with you!

Original Text: カプセルなめるのはあきたレロ～。\nキミのことなめさせてくれレロ～。
Translated Text:
I'm tired of licking
capsules, Lero~. Let me lick
you, Lero~.

Original Text: 【出：だ】したことを【後悔：こうかい】するよ…。\nずっと　なめ【続：つづ】けてやる…。
Translated Text:
You'll regret doing that...
I'm going to keep making
you pay for it forever...

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがとな。\nお【前：まえ】とは　いいともだちになれそうだ。
Translated Text:
Thanks for letting me out.
I think we'll make good friends.

Original Text: 【田：た】んぼのにおいがするわい！\nおで　あんたのこと【気：き】に【入：い】ったぞ。
Translated Text:
It smells like a rice paddy!
Hey, I really like you.

Original Text: 【田：た】をかえせー！　【田：た】をかえせー！\nおでの【田：た】んぼ　【見：み】つけてくれー！
Translated Text:
Give me back my rice field!
Give me back my rice field!
Please find my rice field!

Original Text: そうだ　あきらめるな！\nオレと【一緒：いっしょ】に　きたえようぜ！
Translated Text:
That's right—don't give up! Let's train
together!

Original Text: うぉぉ！　お【主：ぬし】が【出：だ】してくれたのか！\nこれで【思：おも】う【存分：ぞんぶん】　【掃除：そうじ】ができる！
Translated Text:
Whoa! So you're the
one who gave me this!
Now I can clean to my heart's content!

Original Text: ここから【出：で】る【時：とき】を【待：ま】っていた。\nきみといっしょに【行：い】こう。
Translated Text:
I've been waiting for the
moment to leave here.
Let's go together.

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれて　【感謝：かんしゃ】する。\nさあ　いっしょに【鬼退治：おにたいじ】だ！
Translated Text:
Thank you for letting me join.
Now, let's go defeat the demons together!

Original Text: ふぃ～！　やっと【出：で】れたわい！\nお【礼：れい】に　ワイが【鬼：おに】を【食：く】ってやろう！
Translated Text:
Phew! I finally made it out!
To show my thanks, I'm
gonna eat that demon!

Original Text: おいさんの【命：たま】　うまそうやんけ。\nめっちゃ【気：き】に【入：い】ったでぇ！
Translated Text:
Oisan's Life... That looks delicious. I
really like it!

Original Text: びっくりして　ひっくりかえっちまった！\nこんなオレだけど　【連：つ】れて【行：い】ってくれよ！
Translated Text:
I was so surprised I fell over!
Even though I'm like this,
please take me with you!

Original Text: わ～い　お【外：そと】に【出：で】られた～。\nふわ～　おともだちになってもいい？
Translated Text:
Yay! I got to go outside!
Aww... Can we be friends?

Original Text: 【当：あ】てられてゴメン！　いったんゴメン！\nあやまるから　【友：とも】だちになりましょうよ～。
Translated Text:
Sorry for hitting you! Sorry about that!
I'll apologize, so let's be friends~.

Original Text: モノマネしてたら【出：で】れなくなっちゃったー。\nつぎは　キミのまねさせてー。
Translated Text:
I got so caught up in doing an
impersonation that I couldn't get out!
Next time, let me do an
impersonation of you.

Original Text: 【私：わたし】は【実：じつ】は【出：だ】してほしくなかったのだ。\nなぁ～んて　ウッソ～！
Translated Text:
Actually, I didn't want to post it.
Just kidding—that's a lie!

Original Text: なんで　こんな【所：ところ】に【入：はい】ってたんでしたっけ？\nあなたが【出：だ】してくれたんですっけ？
Translated Text:
Why was this in here again? Did
you put it here?

Original Text: あらぁ　あたしを【選：えら】んでくれたの？\nふふふ。　おともだちになっちゃう？
Translated Text:
Oh my! Did you pick me?
Hehehe. Want to be friends?

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれたのね。　うれしいわぁ。\nずっと【一緒：いっしょ】がいいな…　ダメぇ？
Translated Text:
So you gave it to me. I'm so happy.
I'd love for us to stay together
forever... Is that okay?

Original Text: 【出：だ】してくれてありがと～。\nおいしいおでんを　【召：め】し【上：あ】がれ～。
Translated Text:
Thanks for making this! Enjoy this
delicious oden!

Original Text: 【出：で】てきちゃって　すみませんでしたー！\nガッカリしたら　ホントすみません！
Translated Text:
I'm so sorry I showed
up! I'm really sorry if I
disappointed you!

Original Text: やっと【出：で】れたよー　ありがとう。\n【未来：みらい】までおともするよ～。
Translated Text:
I finally made it out! Thanks. I'll
be with you all the way into the
future.

Original Text: 【見：み】つかっちゃったケーン！\nオレ　ともだちになっちゃうぞ！
Translated Text:
I found you, Kane!
I'm gonna be your friend!

Original Text: ナフーン！　よく【見：み】つけたな！\n【風魔：ふうま】の【力：ちから】　お【前：まえ】に【貸：か】してやる！
Translated Text:
Nafoon! Good find!
I'll lend you the power of Fuma!

Original Text: どっきーん！　【急：きゅう】に【外：そと】に【出：で】られてびっくり！\nでも　うれしいよ～。　ありがと～。
Translated Text:
Thump! I was so surprised
to suddenly be let outside!
But I'm happy~. Thanks~.

Original Text: う～ら～や～め～し～。\nきみから　おかずのにおいがする～。
Translated Text:
Oooh, I'm so jealous~.
I can smell the side
dishes coming from you~.

Original Text: カプセルの【中：なか】　あつすぎ！\n【出：だ】してくれてありがとー。
Translated Text:
Inside the capsule... It's
way too hot! Thanks for
letting me out.

Original Text: アンタを【見：み】て　ビビッときたぜ！\nこれからもよろしくな！
Translated Text:
I got a real spark when I saw you!
Looking forward to hanging out with you
from now on!

Original Text: 【迷：まよ】ってたら　【閉：と】じ【込：こ】められました…。\n【出：だ】してくれて　ありがとうございます～。
Translated Text:
I got lost and ended up getting locked in...
Thank you so much for letting me out!

Original Text: ワシを【盗：ぬす】むつもりか！\n【盗：ぬす】まれちゃってもいいけど！
Translated Text:
Are you trying to steal me?!
Well, I guess it's okay if you
do!

Original Text: おいどんを【出：だ】すとは　【大物：おおもの】ばい！\nおまえのこと【気：き】に【入：い】ったばい！
Translated Text:
To bring me out like
that—you're a big shot!
I like you, man!

Original Text: 【脱線：だっせん】しちゃって【出：で】れなくなってた！\nきみのところに【行：い】けばいいんだな！
Translated Text:
I got sidetracked and couldn't get
out! So I guess I just need to go to
your place!

Original Text: 【目：め】が【回：まわ】っちまったぁ！\nでも　【出：だ】してくれてありがとよぉ。
Translated Text:
My head's spinning!
But thanks for letting me out.

Original Text: キラメキ～！\n【今日：きょう】からいっしょに　キラメキ～！
Translated Text:
Sparkle~!
Starting today, let's sparkle together~!

Original Text: キミ　なかなか【肉食系：にくしょくけい】じゃん？\nそういうやつ【好：す】きだぜ！
Translated Text:
Hey, you're pretty aggressive,
aren't you? I really like girls
like that!

Original Text: 【雷：かみなり】に【当：あ】てられた【気分：きぶん】だぜ！\n【今日：きょう】からオレたちは【友：とも】だちだ！
Translated Text:
I feel like I just got struck
by lightning! Starting
today, we're friends!

Original Text: カプセルに【閉：と】じこめられるなんて\nなんてことないわい！
Translated Text: Being trapped in a capsule?\nThat's no big deal!

Original Text: ゲコゲーコ！　【大：おお】ガマ【参上：さんじょう】！\n【出：だ】してくれてサンキューな！
Translated Text:
Croak, croak! The Giant
Toad is here! Thanks for
letting me out!

Original Text: カプセルの【中：なか】　【気：き】に【入：い】ってたんだけど…。\n【仕方：しかた】ない…　【新：あたら】しい【家探：いえさが】すか…。
Translated Text:
Inside the capsule... I
really liked it, though...
Oh well... I guess I'll have
to look for a new place...

Original Text: おいら【無表情：むひょうじょう】だけど　【感謝：かんしゃ】してるよ～。\nお【友：とも】だちにしてくれるよね？
Translated Text:
I might not show it, but I'm
really grateful. You'll be my
friend, right?

Original Text: 【一目見：ひとめみ】て【気：き】に【入：い】ったよ！\nこれからよろしくね～！
Translated Text:
I liked it the moment I saw it! Looking
forward to working with you!
